programme.title: Murder Under Glass
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the murder of a gourmet restaurant owner who had been the victim of an extortionist.

programme.title: Make Me a Perfect Murder
programme.desc: A TV-network executive murders her boss and lover when he fails to promote her.

programme.title: How to Dial a Murder
programme.desc: Columbo suspects a psychologist (Nicol Williamson), a noted expert in mind control, is guilty of murder.

programme.title: The Conspirators
programme.desc: An Irish poet, who fronts a peace organization while secretly running guns, kills an arms dealer who tries to swindle him.

programme.title: Columbo Goes to the Guillotine
programme.desc: An egocentric psychic murders his old mentor, a magician charged to expose him as fraud, by beheading him while he's rehearsing his guillotine trick.

programme.title: Murder, Smoke and Shadows
programme.desc: A Hollywood director tries to fool Columbo when a studio becomes a murder scene.

programme.title: Sex and the Married Detective
programme.desc: The disheveled detective gets some free advice from a world-famous sex therapist.

programme.title: Grand Deceptions
programme.desc: The detective is called in to investigate the death of a sergeant major at a training camp.

programme.title: Murder, a Self Portrait
programme.desc: Homicide detective Lieutenant Columbo investigates the murder of a famous painter's ex-wife.

programme.title: Columbo Cries Wolf
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the disappearance of the director of a men's magazine.

programme.title: Agenda for Murder
programme.desc: The disheveled detective investigates the apparent suicide of a notorious racketeer who was facing an indictment.

programme.title: Rest in Peace, Mrs. Columbo
programme.desc: When a crooked estate agent dies in prison, his widow vows to exact her revenge on the two men that put him there. After killing her husband's informing boss, she sets her sights on Lieutenant Columbo.

programme.title: Uneasy Lies the Crown
programme.desc: A dentist frames his wife for a murder in order to keep up his image and expensive lifestyle.

programme.title: Murder in Malibu
programme.desc: A famous romance novelist is shot dead in the course of what looks like a robbery.

programme.title: Columbo Goes to College
programme.desc: The rumpled lieutenant is invited to give a college lecture on criminology but ends up investigating the murder of one of the institution's professors.

programme.title: Caution: Murder Can Be Hazardous to Your Health
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the murder of a crime show host's rival with incriminating evidence.

programme.title: Columbo and the Murder of a Rock Star
programme.desc: Columbo is put to the test against an equally brilliant, criminal defense lawyer who murders his rock star girlfriend.

programme.title: Death Hits the Jackpot
programme.desc: A police detective questions a jewelry-store owner whose late nephew had a winning lottery ticket.

programme.title: No Time to Die
programme.desc: Columbo attends his nephew's wedding and as the couple get ready to leave on their honeymoon, the bride disappears; Columbo investigates and suspects his nephew may have made a few enemies on the police force.

programme.title: A Bird in the Hand...
programme.desc: Columbo investigates a hit-and-run, followed by a car explosion.

programme.title: It's All in the Game
programme.desc: Two women kill their two-timing lover but have solid alibis; one of the women tries to seduce Columbo to keep him off her trail.

programme.title: Butterfly in Shades of Grey
programme.desc: Columbo investigates a case involving argumentative radio talk show host Fielding Chase.

programme.title: Undercover
programme.desc: The disheveled detective sets out to solve an unusual double murder in which two men have apparently killed each other.

programme.title: Strange Bedfellows
programme.desc: The detective is put on the case of a man who murders his brother.

programme.title: A Trace of Murder
programme.desc: Columbo matches wits with a forensics specialist, helping his girlfriend to frame her husband for a stockbroker's murder.

programme.title: Ashes to Ashes
programme.desc: The inimitable cop must prove that a flamboyant Hollywood gossip reporter was murdered by her former lover.

programme.title: Murder With Too Many Notes
programme.desc: A Hollywood film composer and conductor murders a talented, young musician out of jealousy.

programme.title: Columbo Likes the Nightlife
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the apparent suicide of a tabloid reporter in the Los Angeles rave scene.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims...

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems...or their own lives.

programme.title: Anti-Trust
programme.desc: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

programme.title: RoboCop (2014)
programme.desc: In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

programme.title: Pray For Death
programme.desc: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

programme.title: Rage Of Honor
programme.desc: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Detective Jack Caine (Dolph Lundgren) thought he;d dealt with every kind of crime on earth, but someone "or something" is using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

programme.title: Code Of Silence
programme.desc: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

programme.title: 10 To Midnight
programme.desc: Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

programme.title: Assassination
programme.desc: Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

programme.title: Murphy's Law
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: At Close Range
programme.desc: A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.

programme.title: State Of Grace
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner, who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Robert is a former CIA agent who lives a life of tranquility at a secret resort in the woods. One day, his estranged son drives to the camp for a visit -- but he's followed by Robert's old nemesis, Balzary. As Balzary and his squad launch an all-out attack, father and son retreat to a high-tech bunker that has steel walls and advanced weapons.

programme.title: Inherit the Viper
programme.desc: For siblings Kip and Josie, dealing opioids isn't just their family business -- it's their only means of survival. When a deal goes fatally wrong, Kip decides he wants out for good. But his attempt to escape his family's legacy soon ignites a powder keg of violence and betrayal, endangering Kip, Josie and their younger brother.

programme.title: Life of Crime
programme.desc: Double-crosses and plot twists abound when a corrupt real-estate developer (Tim Robbins) decides not to pay a ransom to his wife's (Jennifer Aniston) kidnappers (John Hawkes, Yasiin Bey).

programme.title: Cash Out
programme.desc: Tempted by what could be his biggest score ever, professional thief Mason joins forces with his younger brother to rob a bank. However, when the heist goes awry, the thieves find themselves trapped inside, surrounded by SWAT teams, the FBI and Interpol. Things get even more tense when Mason eventually talks to the lead negotiator -- his former lover.

programme.title: Confidence
programme.desc: In this glossy neo-noir caper, expert grifter Jake Vig (Edward Burns) inadvertently crosses volatile crime boss the King (Dustin Hoffman) and, to make it right, he must agree to con banker Morgan Price (Robert Forster). He assembles his team, including Lily (Rachel Weisz) and Gordo (Paul Giamatti), but things get complicated fast with the arrival of Special Agent Gunther Butan (Andy Garcia), who has been tracking Jake for years. As the con goes down, Jake can't say who's double-crossing whom.

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes
programme.desc: Gunner is a special forces soldier who returns to the field of battle to save his kidnapped niece in South America. He and his team soon discover that her disappearance is part of a corrupt private operation that hits way too close to home.

programme.title: Marauders
programme.desc: FBI agents (Christopher Meloni, Dave Bautista) uncover a conspiracy while trying to nail a group of deadly bank robbers.

programme.title: No Escape
programme.desc: American businessman Jack Dwyer, wife Annie and their two young daughters arrive in Southeast Asia to begin a new life. As his company plans to improve the region's water quality, the family quickly learns that they're right in the middle of a political uprising. Armed rebels attack the hotel where they're staying, ordered to kill any foreigners that they encounter. Amid the chaos, Jack must find a way to save himself and his loved ones from the violence erupting all around them.

programme.title: Paradise City
programme.desc: Ryan Swan must carve his way through the Hawaiian crime world to wreak vengeance on the kingpin who murdered his father.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: Trauma Center
programme.desc: Alone and trapped in a locked-down hospital isolation ward overnight, an injured young woman must escape a pair of vicious killers who are after the only piece of evidence that can implicate them in a grisly murder: the bullet in her leg.

programme.desc: Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Meet the Browns
programme.desc: Single mother Brenda (Angela Bassett) suddenly loses her job, then she receives news that the father she never met is dead. With nothing to lose, she gathers her brood and heads to Georgia, where she meets her father's uproarious family for the first time and finds the tentative beginnings of a new romance.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's the Family That Preys
programme.desc: Despite their differences in social class, Charlotte (Kathy Bates) and Alice (Alfre Woodard) are good friends for many years. Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

programme.title: The Single Moms Club
programme.desc: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

programme.desc: Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

programme.title: Rambo
programme.desc: Having long-since abandoned his life as a lethal soldier, John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) lives a solitary life near the Thai border. Two weeks after guiding a missionary (Julie Benz) and her comrades into Burma, he gets an urgent call for help. The missionaries have not returned, and although he is reluctant to embrace violence again, Rambo sets out to rescue the captives from the Burmese army.

programme.title: Rambo: Last Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran John Rambo tries to find some semblance of peace by raising horses on a ranch in Arizona. He's also developed a special familial bond with a woman named Maria and her teenage granddaughter Gabriela. But when a vicious Mexican cartel kidnaps Gabriela, Rambo crosses the border on a bloody and personal quest to rescue her and punish those responsible.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: The Expendables 4
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.

programme.title: Prison Cell to Wedding Bells

programme.title: The Virgin & The Trick
programme.desc: Clint plans to marry a prisoner he's never met; Caitlin keeps a mother of a secret from Matt; tensions flare when Scott meets his soon-to-be stepdaughter; Virgin Megan is secretly engaged to an inmate who's keeping a big secret of his own.

programme.desc: Megan and Sarah plan to wed the same inmate, but Sarah has a secret; Scott waits for Lizzie's release, and tensions arise when he's joined by the daughter she hasn't seen in almost a decade; Caitlin is stopped by police at Matt's release.

programme.title: I Want This to Be Real
programme.desc: Scott fears he's Lizzie's "trick" and has a major meltdown leading to their first fight; at Matt's release, Caitlin inspects her man; Michael's wife and girlfriend make plans to pick him up from prison.

programme.title: Washing Off Prison
programme.desc: Matt and Caitlin's sexy reunion leads to a surprising offer; at Tracie's release, Clint fears she's catfishing him; Brittany walks out on her first date with Marcelino; Sarah picks up Michael from prison, but he's harboring a scandalous secret.

programme.title: Secrets and Cellmates
programme.desc: Ex-con Michael juggles his wife and girlfriend; Lizzie gives Scott a makeover, but her daughter wants him out; Clint proposes the same day he meets Tracie; Caitlin and Matt move in with mother; Marcelino meets Brittany's bunkmate.

programme.title: Your Card Has Been Declined
programme.desc: Brittany has a secret rendezvous with her ex-girlfriend; Michael romances both Megan and Sarah; Clint waits at the altar alone; Matt meets Caitlin's mother, but Caitlin loses it and storms off.

programme.title: Rings and Runaways
programme.desc: Michael goes ring shopping with his wife, but he plans a secret trip with his girlfriend; Clint marries Tracie, but he awakens to a nightmare; Matt shocks Caitlin on their first date; Marcelino fears being a stepfather.

programme.title: She Said Yes?
programme.desc: Scott stuns Lizzie; Megan and Michael rendezvous for the first time outside of prison, but wife Sarah has a shocking secret; Brittany brings her ex wedding dress shopping; Matt's drinking worries Caitlin; Clint breaks down over missing Tracie.

programme.title: The $800K Hustle
programme.desc: Lizzie confesses to an $800,000 hustle; Megan expects a proposal from Michael; Matt's temper flares at a job interview; Brittany reveals a secret to Marcelino; Clint reveals shocking details about the night Tracie went on the run.

programme.title: She Has to Go
programme.desc: Megan's last-minute visit shakes Michael when his mother objects; Brittany's party takes a turn when her ex arrives, and she's forced to reveal her secret; Scott has a big surprise for Lizzie; Clint gets a shocking phone call from Tracie.

programme.title: The English Patient

programme.title: Pain in the Neck
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly frustrated about being cooped up around the house.

programme.title: Ozzy Knows Best
programme.desc: Ozzy is upset by Kelly's tendency to wear revealing outfits when she goes out to clubs and parties.

programme.title: Valentine Daze
programme.desc: Kelly continues to spend time with Rob, but doesn't want to be his girlfriend.

programme.title: Sleepless in Beverly Hills

programme.title: Have Ozz Will Travel
programme.desc: The family tries to decide where to go on vacation. Sharon turns down Fiji because none of the hotels meet her standards, while Ozzy nixes a number of other locations for various reasons.

programme.title: Hawaii Five Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy, Sharon and Jack head to Hawaii for their vacation. Ozzy continues to be miserable for a while but cheers up following a private luau. Jack goes diving in a shark cage. His friends invite strippers to the luau and behave in ways that embarrass him. The traveling party winds up leaving without Jack's friends when they fail to show up on time for their flight.

programme.title: Kelly Interupted
programme.desc: Kelly irritates her mother by getting a lip ring. Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: Charity Case
programme.desc: Sharon and Kelly plan a trip to Kenya on behalf of a charity organization. Ozzy doesn't want them to go, as he fears they will be kidnapped or contract malaria. Sharon also has second thoughts after hearing more details about the trip.

programme.title: Number One Fan
programme.desc: A 25-year-old fan wins a charity auction for the right to spend the day with Sharon. Sharon is touched by the woman's generosity and invites her to spend the night at the Osbourne home. Meanwhile, Jack must attend an online traffic school after getting a speeding ticket.

programme.title: Lost in Translation
programme.desc: The family travels to Japan, where Ozzy is to receive the Legend Award at the Video Music Awards. Kelly also makes several personal appearances. One of the employees, Sam, meets with some family members whom he hasn't seen in years, but can only communicate with them through a translator.

programme.title: The Show Must Go Off
programme.desc: Sharon's talk show tapes its final episodes. Feeling mistreated, Sharon clashes with her bosses to the very end, showing up late on purpose and demanding money upfront.

programme.title: A Farewell to Ozz
programme.desc: Dr. Phil McGraw pays a visit to the house, where he holds a frank discussion with the Osbournes about drug abuse and other issues that have affected the family's relationships with one another.

programme.title: A House Divided
programme.desc: Ozzy appears on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno as a performer.

programme.title: Bark At The Moon
programme.desc: The family's dogs have been excreting far too many times in the house and ruining furniture in the process.

programme.title: Like Father Like Daughter
programme.desc: Ozzy releases his first solo album in six years.

programme.title: Won't You Be My Neighbour
programme.desc: Kelly complains that elder sister Aimee had booked her a gynaecologist appointment.

programme.title: Tour of Duty
programme.desc: Ozzy is working out with a personal trainer in preparation for an upcoming tour.

programme.title: Break A Leg
programme.desc: Ozzy is touring while Sharon returns home, planning to reunite with Ozzy in Houston because she misses him.

programme.title: Get Stuffed
programme.desc: Ozzy mixes alcohol with the pain medication for his foot injury and winds up stoned.

programme.title: The Ozz Man and the Sea
programme.desc: Kelly takes off for her European singing tour; Jack makes his acting debut on "Dawson's Creek"; Ozzy tries to build a beach fire for Sharon and makes a comical attempt at deep-sea fishing.

programme.desc: Kelly reluctantly brings home her first boyfriend, evoking motherly concern from Sharon, who tries to nip the romance in the bud.

programme.desc: Kelly grows frustrated with all the appearances she must make as a recording artist.

programme.desc: As the railroad prepares to leave Cheyenne behind after Sherman Peak; Cullen returns to Fort Smith to get his family.

programme.desc: Lizzy is a tough, resourceful frontierswoman settling a remote stretch of land on the 19th-century American frontier. When a newlywed couple arrive at a nearby homestead, their presence amplifies Lizzy's fears, setting into motion a shocking chain of events.

programme.title: White Justice

programme.title: Struck

programme.title: Any Sum Within Reason

Do-won, "The Good", is a bounty hunter, out to track down Chang-yee, "The Bad", a charismatic hit man attempting to steal the map from a military official. However, the ruthless Tae-goo puts a hitch in both their plans when he secures the map for himself.

programme.title: Murder at Yellowstone City
programme.desc: The once peaceful and booming Yellowstone City has fallen on hard times, but when a local prospector strikes gold, things seem to turn around. However, any hope is soon shattered when the prospector is found dead and the sheriff quickly arrests a mysterious newcomer. As the brutal murders continue, worried residents start to prepare for a final showdown that pits neighbor against neighbor.

programme.title: The Ruthless Four

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle: What is the Real Story of Christmas?
programme.desc: For 2,000 years the birth of Jesus has been celebrated. Can the New Testament solve the mysteries of Christmas? New evidence provides a surprising look at the first Christmas.

programme.title: Jesus' Birth: Is the Miracle to Christmas True?
programme.desc: Two thousand years ago Jesus Christ was born. Did He really exist? Experience the joy and wonder of those who witnessed the Christmas miracle - the birth of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: The Birth of Jesus
programme.desc: In Christian theology the nativity marks the birth of Jesus in fulfillment of the divine will of God, to save the world from sin. John used baptism as the central symbol or sacrament of his messianic movement. John baptized Jesus.

programme.title: James, Jesus' Brother
programme.desc: In the first years, why did James, referred to as the 'brother of the Lord,' appear to be the veritable successor to Jesus? Did Jesus have brothers? programme.title: The Life of Joseph Part 2
programme.desc: Joseph is reunited with his father and brothers.

programme.title: Biblical Women
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. programme.title: The Savior
programme.desc: The story of the Man, His times, and His message. Taken directly from the Gospel of Luke and filmed in Israel and Palestine.

programme.title: Jesus' Silent Years: Where Was Jesus All Those Years?

programme.title: The Final 24 Hours of Jesus' Life
programme.desc: Seth explores the final 24 hours in the life of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Early Years of Jesus

Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Apparition of Mary: Was There a Miracle at Fatima?
programme.desc: In 1917, two little girls and one small boy claimed to see and hear the Virgin Mary near Fatima, Portugal. What did the Fatima children witness? Learn the surprising answers.

programme.title: The Last Supper
programme.desc: The Last Supper is the final meal that, in the Gospel accounts, Jesus shared with his Apostles in Jerusalem before his crucifixion.

programme.title: Twelve Ordinary Men
programme.desc: A look at the twelve disciples who were hand-picked by Jesus to learn from his teachings, and spread the gospel after his crucifixion. Why these men?

programme.title: Philosopher
programme.desc: Paul's background gave him a good understanding of Greek culture and philosophies. But to him the Gospel wasn't philosophy, it was truth and unlike the monasteries of Meteora, where monks hid their faith away, Paul engaged with the philosophers of his day in the market place. In Athens he was invited to address the Council of the Areopagus about the resurrection and 'Unknown God'.

programme.title: Scarlet Woman: The True Story of Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: Mary Magdalene is a familiar presence in modern culture. We've read about her in the Da Vinci Code. We've heard about her in Jesus Christ Superstar. We think we know the story well. Yet in actual fact we don't know it at all because it's all a fantasy. For a thousand years, the Mary Magdalene story has been one of art's most tremulous myths. In the Bible, she warrants just four actual mentions.

programme.title: Peter
programme.desc: St Peter's Basilica in Rome is the centre of the Roman Catholic faith. But the man who it is named after, knew nothing but fishing for the first part of his life. Following the death and resurrection of Jesus, Peter became a missionary of the Christian Church. From the shores of the Sea of Galilee to the might of Rome, Peter became one of the young churches first missionaries.

programme.title: Mystery of the Shroud
programme.desc: In a tomb located in Jerusalem's Hell Valley, on land bought with Judas Iscariot's bloodstained silver, a sensational discovery was made. Vital information has been uncovered to paint a picture of what Jesus' grave would have looked like and what his burial process involved. One of the key moments in Christian history is made real and contemporary through this exciting archaeological discovery.

programme.desc: Lee Strobel's blockbuster bestseller comes alive on your screen in this documentary that chronicles the reporter's journey from atheism to faith. The former legal editor of the Chicago Tribune draws upon his investigative skills to examine the historical viability and accuracy of the Gospels, along with the personal claims and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Come Follow Me
programme.desc: Come Follow Me dramatizes the relationship between Jesus and the Apostle Peter. From the day Peter heard Jesus call his name to the post-resurrection conversation in which Jesus charges Peter to 'feed my sheep,' this short film beautifully illustrates Peter's transformation from fearful denier to the bold leader of the early church.

programme.title: Herod's Temple: The Temple Jesus Knew
programme.desc: Jerusalem, rich in historical and Biblical heritage, is the home of the Temple Mount, one of the world's most recognizable and visited sacred sites. Now, travel back in time to see it the way Jesus and his disciples did over 2,000 years ago. They knew it as Herod's Temple. We remember it as the Temple Jesus knew.

programme.desc: The story of the Man, His times, and His message. Taken directly from the Gospel of Luke and filmed in Israel and Palestine.

programme.title: Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: From very early on, Mary was given the title 'Apostle of the Apostles'. We follow her career as a close follower of Jesus and, contrary to popular belief, show how she is a role model for the Christian life and a powerful feminist voice.

programme.title: The Tomb of Jesus
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Path Of The Wind
programme.desc: As an ex-convict, Lee Ferguson's biggest desire is to leave his past behind and make a fresh start with Katie, his new love. But when Lee finds out Katie is a Christian, his pre-conceived ideas and her moral standards clash. Through engaging action and drama, this film explores temptation, sin, forgiveness and redemption, while helping seekers and believers understand one another!

programme.title: Jeremy's Egg
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jeremy is terminally ill and the only special-needs child in second grade. One day his teacher gives her students plastic eggs with the instructions to fill them with something that symbolizes Easter and new life.

Following the death and resurrection of Jesus, Peter became a missionary of the Christian Church. From the shores of the Sea of Galilee to the might of Rome, Peter became one of the young churches first missionaries.

programme.title: The Passion
programme.desc: The tragedy and victory of the New Testament. Follow Jesus through the Last Supper, His betrayal by Judas in Gethsemane, His trial before Pilate and the crowds, His Crucifixion, and the joyful triumph of His Resurrection and Ascension. He is Risen.

programme.title: The Lamp
programme.desc: Life goes on? A tale of hope, wishes, dreams, and what can happen when you just believe. Two years after the tragedy a visit from a mysterious and magical messenger, who offers Stanley three wishes, just may reawaken his hope for the future. With a little help from a couple of needy foster kids next door, Stanley and Lisa find that all their wishes can come true if they just believe.

programme.title: Solomon
programme.desc: Solomon is crowned King of Israel and rules the land with love, peace and respect. While visiting the city, Solomon meets the beautiful Queen of Sheba and falls in love. When she returns to her homeland, Solomon falls into a deep depression, departing from his once idyllic world of peace and luxury while his kingdom threatens to collapse.

programme.title: Life Fine Tuned
programme.desc: A spoiled young pop star learns a lesson in humility after being cut from her big show and replaced with a stand-in. Now lost in rural Virginia she must learn how to get in tune with those around her. This family friendly comedy-drama is ideal for tweens and young teens. It addresses issues of identity, humility, family and salvation.

programme.title: Betrayal of Trust
programme.desc: Based on investigative journalist Chris Moore's book, and seen on BBC, this powerful drama tells the horrific story of Father Brendan Smyth, who evaded detection as a serial child abuser for thirty years, in no small part in thanks to the collusion of the Head Abbott in the Nobentine order.

programme.title: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: From the Emmy Award-winning Bible Collection comes a production starring Richard Harris as the Apostle John. Detailing John's visions against the backdrop of the severe persecution of Christians in the first century, this biblically based film will inspire viewers.

programme.title: Hudson Taylor: Into the Heart of the Dragon
programme.desc: Into the Heart of the Dragon is a striking docudrama filmed on location in China and the U.K. It paints an intimate portrait of Taylor's life and legacy.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: Genesis traces the beloved Christian stories of creation. Genesis shows viewers Adam and Eve in Paradise until they are tempted by the snake, traces the trials of Cain and Abel as Abel is driven to murder his brother and recounts the epic story of Noah and the Ark where Noah is commanded by God to save two of every creature from the flood.

programme.title: Milltown Pride
programme.desc: Milltown Pride is an entertaining evangelistic movie that recalls a bygone era while conveying relevant truths for today. Milltown Pride tells of a young man who dreams of playing professional baseball, his rise as a baseball star, his fall from grace, and the redemption he finds through faith and love.

programme.title: Corrie ten Boom: A Faith Undefeated
programme.desc: When Nazi forces invaded Holland in 1940 and began rounding up Jews, Corrie ten Boom, her sister Betsie, and their elderly father risked their lives to save as many as possible. A hidden room was secretly built in their home where the oppressed Jews took refuge until a Gestapo raid put an end to their operation. Corrie ten Boom.

programme.title: Romero Collector's Edition
programme.desc: In honor of Archbishop Oscar Romero of El Salvador, the Romero Collector's Edition film has been remastered and chronicles the amazing true transformation of an apolitical, complacent priest to a committed leader, who started a revolution without guns, without an army, without fear.

programme.desc: Our 2001 straight axle Tacoma goes exploring at Adventure Off-Road Park.

programme.title: Sleeving a 396 Big Block for a 1970 Camaro
programme.desc: The car has to be converted from automatic to manual floor pedals, and the firewall gets some factory style mods that change the car over to big-block style. Then, everything you ever wanted to know about brake lines and fuel lines.

programme.title: OEM Ford F-100 Suspension Swap
programme.desc: Shockingly, a sixty-year-old suspension needs replacing. So, Eric and Joel kick it old school with some OEM parts for Clint Black's 1960 Ford F-100.

programme.title: Installing Tacoma Suspension Upgrades
programme.desc: Our Tacoma get suspension upgrades for our Straight Axle Toyota. Plus, our Pre-Runner Ranger gets alignment ready.

programme.title: Installing a 5.0L Coyote Drivetrain
programme.desc: Our Pre-Runner Ranger gets a 5.0L Coyote and beefy transmission for maximum off-road action.

programme.title: Turning An Old Crown Vic Cruiser Into A Track Panther - Part 1
programme.desc: We start working on a new project with the novice racer in mind. We take a 2008 Ford Crown Vic Police Cruiser and turn it into a budget-friendly Spec Panther racing machine! Today we'll upgrade our transmission for better shifting and give the old power plant a tune-up.

programme.title: In-Depth Build Of An Old School Chevy 4.3L V6 Build Part 2
programme.desc: Once we install ported cylinder heads, upgraded valvetrain, and induction...the 4.3L engine shows what it can do in the dyno cell!

programme.title: The Great Intake Debate: Dual Vs. Single Plane Intake Manifolds
programme.desc: We test multiple configurations of our V8 to see what makes the biggest difference on the engine dyno.

programme.title: Lifting Big with 8" BDS Coilover Conversion and 35" Tires
programme.desc: We jack up the '14 Silverado and add big wheels, tires, and brake upgrades.

programme.title: '65 Chevy C10 and '96 Ram 3500
programme.desc: The '65 Chevy C10 gets prepped for a custom interior, plus we we go to a viewer's home to rescue a '96 Ram 3500.

programme.title: Horsepower, Brakes, and Tone for a Rare 2014 CTS-V Wagon
programme.desc: Can the Blacktop Speed Shop crew turn this rare 2014 Cadillac CTS-V Wagon from a 1 of 400 ever made into a 1 of 1 unicorn for the EBC Brakes' booth at SEMA?

programme.title: Beefing Up Our 460 Big Block Ford
programme.desc: Pat and Frankie upgrade some internal components to make our blue oval beast more durable under boost. When it's back together we will see what our changes make on the engine dyno!

programme.title: Add an Extra 100HP to a Ford Windsor
programme.desc: More hi-po how-to for an extra 100 horsepower out of 408 Windsor Stroker. Plus, Engine Power attends the MATCO Tool Expo.

programme.title: Improving The Air Intake And Sound On The 2020 F-150 Sport Truck
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes giveaway 2020 F150 wraps up with more performance upgrades and a trip to the Grand Ole Opry in Nashville.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 4 Steering Upgrades
programme.desc: Eliza and Jeremy are adding a custom steering setup to their 2002 Ford Pre-Runner Ranger!

programme.title: Bolt-On 100+ Horsepower in a Day
programme.desc: Power upgrades are great especially if you can bolt-on big performance in a day. Mike and Pat grab some wrenches to install a ProCharger supercharger on a 2019 Challenger ProCharger.

programme.title: Building A Naturally Aspirated 6.0L LS Iron Block
programme.desc: We build up a naturally aspirated 6.0 liter LS iron block engine for both track and street duty.

programme.title: Took Our '65 Fleetside Chevy C10 to the Dragstrip and It BROKE
programme.desc: After a year in the shop, the turbo powered 292 straight-six is broken in and hits the road and the track for a run down the 1/8th mile drag strip. Plus we rescue a Toyota Tundra in need of accessories.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 3: Slice and Dice
programme.desc: Our Super Cheyenne needs a little trim. We'll show you how to convert your long bed frame and clearance it to accommodate a new short bed. Plus, we install our rear step notch to get our C-10 in the weeds.

programme.title: Project Creep it Real Part 2
programme.desc: We'll lift our 2012 Jeep JK more than 4 inches and get Dana 60 axles under it!

programme.title: Rolling Again: Suspension, Fuel, and Exhaust
programme.desc: Our Land Cruiser FJ60 build hits a major milestone as we install wheels and tires and add our new suspension system. We fire up the plasma table to cut shackles and crossmember pieces, then install the finished axles and complete the suspension from end to end.

programme.title: Starting Our 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod Build
programme.desc: We have a new project that has a unique lineage in the motorsports world. We bring in a Datsun 280Z and take a look at how it handles on the road and how much power the 2.8 liter makes before we start stripping it down to begin our heritage transformation. Plus, we'll check out the future of automotive innovation at an electrifying event.

programme.title: Building a Custom K1500 Exhaust
programme.desc: LT shows how to build a custom exhaust, and Austin brings new life to a dull paint finish.

programme.title: ProCharged Mustang
programme.desc: Ford's Pony Car gets plenty of pep in its step with a ProCharger setup!

programme.title: Hot Rod LQ9 Cam Swap
programme.desc: Our GM LQ9 engine needs the right ingredients to turn it into a spicy hot rod street bullet.

programme.title: Putting TrackHawk Power Into A 1986 Jeep Wagoneer
programme.desc: The guys visit DBR Performance and their first chance ever to drive a Jeep TrackHawk, which inspires a plan of their own...to turn an old Wagoneer into a screaming street monster.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger gets a Custom Console
programme.desc: The transformation of this off-road beast continues as Eliza and Jeremy complete the interior, install a custom dash, and build a spare tire carrier.

programme.title: Revamped Tahoe Part 1
programme.desc: The Carcass crew bring in a road worn 1996 4X4 two door Tahoe with plans to convert it into the low production two wheel drive version. They'll start by replacing the blue-smoke-puffing V8 and drop in a new powerplant for better performance and reliability. Plus add a suspension to start the transformation.

programme.title: In-Depth Build Of An Old School Chevy 4.3L V6 Build Part 1
programme.desc: Assembly on the 4.3L engine begins with a solid bottom end, including a set of forged pistons and a bigger cam shaft.

programme.title: Chevy DragAlanche - Part 1 Clean Slate Avalanche
programme.desc: A new build hits the shop as the guys take a Chevy Avalanche out for a baseline drive before tearing it down. The interior gets stripped to make room for a roll cage, and the old drivetrain is pulled, setting the stage for serious upgrades and a dual-purpose performance build.

programme.title: Adding Class & Comfort to Our Square Body, Then Parking Lot Revenge
programme.desc: An interior dress-up for a 50 year old tow truck giving it new life on the road.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Gets 1-Ton Dana 60 Axles
programme.desc: The transformation continues on this clean '85 K-10 square body. We remove the cab and axles, then tear it down to the bare chassis. We'll unveil some exciting upgrades to give this '80s TV show knockoff a modern day appeal.

programme.title: F150 Dream Truck Turbo Reloaded
programme.desc: We revisit the F150 Dream Truck and find out what bolt on upgrades actually do to your horsepower numbers, and we'll test it on the dyno.

programme.title: Diesel Deconstruction
programme.desc: With Dragonali about to get torn down, we discuss what goes into planning and building your diesel project truck.

programme.title: 632 ci Big Block Chevy Build for Project Wild & Willys
programme.desc: A high-compression 632 ci Big Block Chevy provides massive power for XOR's Willys Wagon.

programme.title: Taking A 1970 Mustang From Pony To Stallion
programme.desc: This 1970 Mustang will take a 50 year leap into the future, and we're building it to give away! EBC Brakes is teaming up with Detroit Muscle to turn this pony car into a stallion.

programme.title: Will the Ford 300 Inline Six Start After Sitting for 20 Years?
programme.desc: From freeway to farmyard, this rugged straight six was everywhere! It's the subject of our latest build.

programme.title: Adding Posi-traction to our '02 Old School Sierra
programme.desc: We trash the factory Gov-lock rear for a true posi to get both tires spinning. Plus suspension upgrades and a classic throwback exhaust continue our retro build.

programme.title: How to Build a High Power Diesel Beast
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make high power starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.

programme.title: 1996 Tahoe Gets a Classy Chassis
programme.desc: Now that we've got the body off the chassis of our 1996 Chevy Tahoe, we've got a few surprises in store to make this chassis classy all while sticking with our retro theme.

programme.title: Basket Case - Rusted, Busted, and Ruined
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton make a plan of attack to resurrect a 1966 Chevy Nova, a first for the Detroit Muscle shop. After their upscale treatment, this Nova, codenamed Project Starstruck, will be a low, mean, aggressive street machine with killer looks.

programme.title: Tune & Tone
programme.desc: Is custom exhaust worth it on a budget build? The age-old question - does tone matter when dollars do? Will our custom exhaust take our Lexus IS250 up a notch, or will we have to cut back to finish our build.

programme.title: Super Nova Swap
programme.desc: Drag Strip Swap - Tommy and Joel elevate the curb appeal of an old 1967 Chevy Nova race car, showing you how to swap out some shiny stuff, which includes new bumpers and trim, as well as beef up the fire suppression system to get it looking cool and staying cool.

programme.title: Camaro Racecar Body Modifications To Make Room For The Drivetrain
programme.desc: The Carcass crew makes modifications to the firewall of their Road Course Camaro so that the new mounting points for the engine and transmission fit. We'll also show you how to measure for custom wheels for your next project.

programme.title: Supercharged Coyote
programme.desc: The students at SAM TECH build a supercharged Coyote engine to compete at the drag strip.

programme.title: Project Nightshift Putting in Work
programme.desc: Our 1993 Dodge Ram Dually is back in the shop to have its final dress rehearsal. We'll address a common wiring failure point, then we'll install our seats and show you how to refurbish original door panels to make them look brand new and save some money. The guys give you some pointers when measuring for custom driveshafts. Then we clockout and take Nightshift on it's maiden voyage.

programme.title: Building a 1100+ Horsepower Jon Kaase Big Block Ford
programme.desc: Step inside World-class engine builder Jon Kaase's shop. What's the secret to building a 1100+ horsepower bullet, in your own garage?

programme.title: Our '74 Bronco Gets Some Coyote Power and a Classic Paint Job
programme.desc: All of the potential of a new '74 Bronco gets realized with serious engine power, dynamic paint, and a killer suspension, all coming together to make this a one-of-a-kind ride.

programme.title: Medical Checkup
programme.desc: The warden's calling for diagnostics for Detroit Muscle's next prisoner, their 1969 Pontiac GTO. They'll have to tear down and look inside the skeleton of this old muscle car before they fix it up.

programme.title: '56 Chevy Goes Gasser
programme.desc: We finally found a home for our 509 cubic inch W-Series Big Block: A 1956 Chevrolet 210. We start with a frame and a body, and we immediately get to work on getting our high-performance powertrain fitted up.

programme.title: Step by Step Installation of a New Top on Our 1966 Pontiac Convertible
programme.desc: Step by step, we install a new top on our 1966 Pontiac convertible. Plus, a High Performance visit to Las Vegas for LS Fest West.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what's left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: Michael Cimino's Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory - and a cunning woman - to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: Man Of The West
programme.desc: Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that's a fiesta of fun.

programme.title: Invitation To A Gunfighter
programme.desc: Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

programme.title: Return Of The Seven
programme.desc: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

programme.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison...in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: Comes A Horseman
programme.desc: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

programme.title: The Claim
programme.desc: Twenty years after an unforgivable act, a pioneer has amassed immense wealth and a thriving mining town. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catch up to him with the unexpected arrival of three apparent strangers.

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: The Hills Run Red
programme.desc: A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba
programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

programme.title: Death Rides A Horse
programme.desc: Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite
programme.desc: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

programme.title: The Honkers
programme.desc: James Coburn portrays an aging, philandering rodeo cowboy who returns to his hometown. He must do battle not only in the rodeo arena, but with his desire for personal independence and his contradictory desire to win the respect of his wife and son.

programme.title: The Way of the Gun
programme.desc: They make no excuses. They don't ask forgiveness. Their story is without compromise, brutal and simple. For contemporary desperados Parker and associate Longbaugh, crime means survival at any cost. Their impromptu plan to kidnap surrogate mother Robin, just weeks from delivering the son of Hale and Francesca Chidduck, seems to be a fast way to cash in on a fat ransom and head for the border. But their haste does indeed make waste.

programme.title: Catch .44
programme.desc: The plan of three women (Malin Akerman, Nikki Reed, Deborah Ann Woll) to intercept a drug shipment for their boss (Bruce Willis) goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Killing Them Softly
programme.desc: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible.

programme.title: Dig
programme.desc: Held hostage by a dangerous couple, a widower and his daughter must work together to outsmart their captors and survive the night.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: In the summer of 1967, rioting and civil unrest starts to tear apart the city of Detroit. Two days later, a report of gunshots prompts the Detroit Police Department, the Michigan State Police and the Michigan Army National Guard to search and seize an annex of the nearby Algiers Motel. Several policemen start to flout procedure by forcefully and viciously interrogating guests to get a confession. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: Kickboxer 3: The Art of War
programme.desc: A Los Angeles martial artist (Sasha Mitchell) goes to Rio de Janeiro and fights to save a girl from a drug lord.

programme.title: Acts of Violence
programme.desc: Three Midwestern brothers, a crime lord, and an incorruptible cop are on a deadly collision course when the youngest brother's fiancée is kidnapped by human traffickers. To save her, the MacGregor boys call on their military training -- and the strength of family -- to fight the most important battle of their lives.

programme.title: Hunter Killer
programme.desc: American submarine Capt. Joe Glass is on the hunt for a U.S. sub in distress in the Arctic Ocean. He soon learns that a secret Russian coup is in the offing, a conspiracy that threatens to dismantle the world order. With crew and country on the line, Glass must assemble an elite group of Navy SEALs to sneak through enemy waters, rescue the kidnapped Russian president and prevent World War III.

programme.title: Line of Duty
programme.desc: A disgraced cop teams up with a livestreaming news broadcaster to try and save the police chief's kidnapped daughter.

programme.title: Seized
programme.desc: A former special forces agent's son is kidnapped and must now wipe out three dangerous crime syndicates, if he wants to see his son alive again.

programme.title: Escape Plan

programme.title: Sibley Mill
programme.desc: The TWC team is the first to investigate an old confederate gunpowder and fabric factory, Sibley Mill.

programme.title: The Bissman Building

programme.title: USS Edson

programme.title: Old South Pittsburg Hospital
programme.desc: The crew members return to the Old South Pittsburg Hospital, the location of their very first paranormal investigation, where they hope to reveal the true identity of a menacing shadow figure.

programme.title: Peoria State Hospital
programme.desc: The TWC investigate one of the most haunted asylums in the Midwest.

programme.title: Missouri State Penitentiary
programme.desc: The TWC visit Missouri State Penitentiary to banish the spirits of two sinister child killers that still infest its ghostly cellblocks.

programme.title: Castillo de San Marcos

programme.title: Coco Palms Resort

programme.title: Old Crow Distillery
programme.desc: The TWC is called to investigate reports of paranormal activity on the grounds of the Old Crow Distillery.

programme.title: Brushy Mountain Penitentiary
programme.desc: In Tennessee, the team investigates a legendary prison, Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary; the team is taunted and attacked while battling ghosts during an electrical storm.

programme.title: Franklin Castle

programme.title: Randolph County Infirmary
programme.desc: When Nick and Katrina arrive to investigate residual hauntings inside the long-shuttered Randolph County Infirmary in Winchester, Ind., they are alarmed to discover that there are still residents in the building.

programme.title: Monroe House

programme.title: Shrewsbury Prison

programme.title: Scutt Mansion

programme.title: Old Chatham County Jail
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina investigate a haunted jail in Savannah; haunted by phantom noises during their confinement, they realize that they are not alone.

programme.title: Old Sweet Springs
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina submerge themselves among the spirits of West Virginia's Old Sweet Springs Resort to see what lurks beneath the surface of the once-idyllic retreat.

programme.title: Wildwood Sanitarium
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina go to Wildwood Sanitarium; after its conversion into apartments, tenants report an unnerving male presence and furniture being rearranged.

programme.title: Higginsport School
programme.desc: An unknown spirit lurks in the empty hallways of Ohio's Higginsport School; evidence points to darker haunting caused by recent deaths on the property.

programme.title: Bobby Mackey's Music World
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina use high-tech equipment to face down the dark spirits in one of America's most notorious haunted hotspots - Bobby Mackey's Music World.

programme.title: Monroe House
programme.desc: After Nick and Katrina found human bones in their first lockdown at the Monroe House, they thought the case was closed; now they return to explore further.

programme.title: Jim Beam Distillery
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina are in the historic Jim Beam Distillery, exploring employee claims that bourbon is not the only spirit locked inside its huge warehouse.

programme.title: Old Cambria Jail

programme.desc: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey check into a Michigan asylum to determine what truly haunts its abandoned grounds; as the guys sift through the facility's sordid past, they encounter restless souls who refuse to be forgotten in death.

programme.title: Death Sentence
programme.desc: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey investigate the site of Louisiana's first double execution; as they dive into the murky waters of the old Beauregard Parish jail's murderous past, the resident spirits begin to tell an unexpected tale.

programme.title: Go to the Light
programme.desc: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey dive into the Gulf Coast's Pensacola Lighthouse to shine a light on a horrific haunting; as the guys illuminate the site's past, they find the lighthouse itself may play an unexpected role.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey check into Wisconsin's Karsten Hotel to uncover which spirits reside in the once luxurious lodgings; they discover that the terrifying ghostly whispers may reveal unexpected secrets about the hotel's past.

programme.title: Flight or Fright
programme.desc: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey climb aboard the USS Lexington to confront a dark paranormal presence; as they dive into the World War II aircraft carrier's history, they reveal there is more to the haunting than anyone expected.

programme.title: The Axe Man
programme.desc: Dave, Cindy and K.D. investigate a terrifying encounter with an entity in the Cabbage Patch, a former shanty town with a sordid past; the haunting hits close to home when one of the team is attacked by an unseen force and rushed to the hospital.

programme.title: Monster in the Mine
programme.desc: Dave Schrader, Cindy Kaza and K.D. Stafford rush to an opulent stone mansion after two witnesses report an encounter with a ghostly intruder; the team is threatened by spirit voices as they uncover a history of murder and madness.

programme.title: Shadow of Doubt
programme.desc: A terrified couple calls Cindy Kaza, Dave Schrader and K.D. Stafford to their home after the wife wakes to a dark figure choking her; the team's investigation reveals that this house may hold the key to what is haunting Butte and why.

programme.title: Help Us
programme.desc: Butte's Dumas Brothel is famous for its ghosts, but the hauntings have now turned aggressive; to find answers, Dave Schrader, Cindy Kaza and K.D. Stafford contact two female spirits who once worked there.

programme.title: I'm Coming For You
programme.desc: A family is plagued by poltergeist activity and a menacing shadow figure who visits their small son; Dave Schrader, Cindy Kaza and K.D. Stafford wonder if this house could be connected to the vices of old and the darker side of Butte.

programme.title: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: Dave Schrader, Cindy Kaza and K.D. Stafford are called to Butte's historic courthouse after a woman has a strange encounter with an apparition; there, they uncover a history of brutal public executions.

programme.title: End Lines
programme.desc: Dave Schrader, Cindy Kaza and K.D. Stafford have identified the dark entity behind the trouble in Butte; they must confront this monster hundreds of feet below the ground in what could prove to be the most harrowing paranormal battle of their lives.

programme.title: Waverly Hills Sanatorium
programme.desc: The team is back, and their first stop is straight out of a nightmare, Waverly Hills Sanatorium, one of the most haunted locations in America and a place they've feared forever.

programme.title: Missouri State Penitentiary
programme.desc: Dakota blindsides the team when he decides to amp up the fear at what was once the bloodiest prison in America; Chelsea can barely hold it together when the ghost of a child kidnapper won't stop trying to communicate with her.

programme.title: Fort Knox
programme.desc: Dakota hatches a chilling plan to communicate with the dead at an abandoned fort in Maine; a ghostly caretaker threatens to throw them all out into the cold in Maine.

programme.title: Ohio State Reformatory
programme.desc: Fear grips the team at one of America's most depraved prisons.

programme.title: Greene County Almshouse
programme.desc: Fed up with Tanner's and Dakota's experiments, Chelsea picks a revenge location unlike any other for the team.

programme.title: Odd Fellows Home
programme.desc: Hellbent on revenge, long-suffering Alex takes the team to a decaying 240-acre compound in Missouri that once housed a mysterious secret society.

programme.title: Edinburgh Manor
programme.desc: Six years ago, Dakota and Alex foolishly attempted to investigate a haunted husk of a building buried deep in the cornfields of Iowa; now, armed with experience and a team, they've returned to turn the tables on a vengeful poltergeist.

programme.title: Villisca Axe Murder House and Malvern Manor
programme.desc: Dakota doubles down in Iowa for a huge finish to a hellish road trip; he takes the team to two terrifying locations at the same time to investigate one of America's most gruesome cold cases, the Villisca axe murders.

programme.desc: The team finds itself blinded by terror in an abandoned Montana orphanage; when Dakota attempts to tap into the dark energy that permeates the facility, he heaps fear upon the team and communicates with something that may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Old Nazareth Hospital
programme.desc: The team rolls into a Texas town to investigate one of the most haunted hospitals in America; Chelsea is unhappy to discover a haunted doll room.

programme.title: Phelps Dodge Hospital
programme.desc: The team dig deep as they mine their darkest fears at an abandoned Arizona hospital; faced with a vicious entity that hates men, the team get more evidence than they dared hope for.

programme.title: Nevada State Prison
programme.desc: The team heads to one of America's deadliest prisons, a place packed with tortured entities; true fear strikes their hearts when a spirit reaches out to the team for an unimaginable request.

programme.title: Old Adrian Hospital
programme.desc: It's Tanner's turn to pick the next stop, and his plans for revenge take a truly dark turn at a deserted Pennsylvania hospital; dark entities, doppelgängers, and poltergeists lurk around every corner.

programme.title: Indiana State Sanatorium
programme.desc: Alex breaks all the rules when he takes the team to an unexplored location; the Indiana State Sanatorium, which has never been explored and nobody knows what lurks within its walls.

programme.title: Loftus Hall
programme.desc: The team jumps out of their comfort zone and across the pond to the rugged and stormy coast of Ireland; the team is prepared to come face-to-face with poltergeists, ghostly nuns and maybe the Devil himself at a cursed 14th-century mansion.

programme.title: Spike Island
programme.desc: The team's overseas investigation takes them to Ireland's most haunted prison; the dark forces on the island are overwhelming, and terror hits Tanner like a ton of bricks; something else lights up Dakota with a fear he's never experienced before.
