programme.desc: Mark falls head-over-heels in puppy love.

programme.title: The Man from Salinas
programme.desc: Banker Hamilton is closing up for the day when Rudy Gray persuades him to stay open for one more transaction.

programme.title: Two Ounces of Tin
programme.desc: Tip Corey, the son of a man allegedly murdered in North Fork, has a killer's reputation and comes to town to kill Micah.

programme.title: Deadly Image
programme.desc: Len Richards and his brother, Ab, confront a Lucas McCain look-alike, Earl Bantry and his sidekick K.C. Peters, for slaughtering one of Richards' steers.

programme.title: The Debt
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark stop on the way to the county fair to deliver a message to Micah, who is escorting a prisoner to be hanged. Mark and Lucas recognize the prisoner.

programme.title: Tinhorn
programme.desc: Mark and Milly are shocked when Lucas begins gambling. They don't know that Lucas is "undercover" trying to catch a man cheating.

programme.title: None So Blind
programme.desc: Mark befriends singer-banjoist Lafayette Bly, a blind man with an acute sense of hearing and a very strong grip.

programme.title: Jealous Man
programme.desc: A retired lawman's irrational jealousy threatens not only to destroy his marriage but also to make him an easy target for someone who wants him dead.

programme.title: Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: No one is more surprised than Micah when newcomer Leota Carraway claims he's her long-lost husband and the father of her child.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Lucas is torn by conflicting emotions when he meets the town's new preacher, a former outlaw whom the Rifleman vowed to kill.

programme.title: The Day the Town Slept
programme.desc: The town of North Fork becomes a haven for outlaws when suave Ben Judson smooth-talks his way into the marshal's job.

programme.title: Milly's Brother
programme.desc: A handsome gambler moves into town and begins wooing Milly Scott, claiming to have known her deceased brother.

programme.title: Outlaw's Shoes
programme.desc: Lucas develops temporary amnesia from a head injury while visiting a strange town and mistakenly assumes the identity of a wanted criminal.

programme.title: The Executioner
programme.desc: A former neighbor of the McCains' is released from jail after serving his sentence for robbery. Lucas lets the man work for him but the new hand holds a secret.

programme.title: Waste: Part 1
programme.desc: When Lucas, Mark, and Micah get lost in Old Mexico, they are held hostage by a group of bandits who intend to kill the men and take Mark as a slave.

programme.title: Waste: Part 2
programme.desc: While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son and Micah after Mark refuses to leave without him.

programme.title: Lou Mallory
programme.desc: Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.

programme.title: Quiet Night, Deadly Night
programme.desc: When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox hotel occupants are quarantined with an outlaw.

programme.title: Death Never Rides Alone
programme.desc: Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.

programme.title: I Take This Woman
programme.desc: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

programme.title: The Assailants
programme.desc: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

programme.title: Mark's Rifle
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree his character.

programme.title: The Most Amazing Man
programme.desc: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men, until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

programme.title: Squeeze Play
programme.desc: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

programme.title: The Anvil Chorus
programme.desc: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

programme.title: Conflict
programme.desc: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

programme.title: Incident at Line Shack Six
programme.desc: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas' is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

programme.title: Suspicion
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

programme.title: The Sidewinder
programme.desc: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Sixteenth Cousin
programme.desc: The first railroad train is coming to the North Fork station. On board is a Japanese nobleman visiting the US.

programme.title: Hostages to Fortune
programme.desc: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

programme.title: And the Devil Makes Five
programme.desc: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm.

programme.title: End of the Hunt
programme.desc: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

programme.title: The Bullet
programme.desc: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

programme.title: Requiem at Mission Springs
programme.desc: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

programme.title: The Guest
programme.desc: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a friend from Lucas' past. But he has been hired to kill Lucas.

programme.title: Old Man, Running
programme.desc: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

programme.title: Which Way'd They Go?
programme.desc: The lazy Jackman brothers mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town.

programme.title: Old Tony
programme.desc: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

programme.title: The Sharpshooter
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

programme.title: Home Ranch
programme.desc: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

programme.title: End of a Young Gun
programme.desc: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

programme.title: The Marshal
programme.desc: The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.

programme.title: The Brother-In-Law
programme.desc: Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.

programme.title: Eight Hours to Die
programme.desc: A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.

programme.title: Duel of Honor
programme.desc: A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.

programme.title: The Safe Guard
programme.desc: A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.

programme.title: The Sister
programme.desc: When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight.

programme.title: New Orleans Menace
programme.desc: An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork. Spotting the McCain ranch, he tells McCain he wants to buy it.

programme.title: The Apprentice Sheriff
programme.desc: Young Dan Willard takes on Marshal Micah Torrence's job. With no experience, he takes a tough stand with a bunch of Texas cowhands whose high spirits are evident at the saloon.

programme.title: The Angry Gun
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark are returning from a big cattle sale when the stage is robbed by three outlaws. Lucas, desperate to recover the money that was stolen, is determined to pursue the outlaws.

programme.title: The Young Englishman
programme.desc: Lucas gets in trouble when he accuses the foreman of a neighboring ranch of rustling some of his cattle.

programme.title: The Gaucho
programme.desc: An Argentine family moves to North Fork. The townspeople are unfriendly to them, making fun of their clothing and customs. The Argentinean adult immigrant is openly hostile in return.

programme.title: The Pet
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax after they adopt a stray horse whose owner has been killed in a gunfight.

programme.title: The Sheridan Story
programme.desc: After the end of the Civil War, General Phil Sheridan, who has been appointed Governor of the New Mexico Territory, is on an inspection tour of the country.

programme.title: The Retired Gun
programme.desc: A famous gunfighter marries and decides to retire. He and his wife settle down in North Fork and open a store, but three outlaws arrive in town looking to best him in a gunfight.

programme.title: The Photographer
programme.desc: An old friend of Lucas McCain's, a traveling photographer, comes to North Fork plying his trade. When a murder is committed, the photographer is accused of the crime.

programme.title: Shivaree
programme.desc: The townsfolk of North Fork decide to give a young couple a shivaree celebration. When the drunken crowd gets out of hand and roughs up the bride-to-be, the young groom challenges them.

programme.title: The Deadeye Kid
programme.desc: When a young boy from Brooklyn is accused of murder, Mark, believing the boy's claim of innocence, hides him until he can find the real killer.

programme.title: The Indian
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart arrives in search of renegade Indians suspected of the murder of a Texas Ranger.

programme.title: The Boarding House
programme.desc: Sid Fallon tries to blackmail a former gambler into allowing him to use her boarding house as a gambling hall.

programme.title: The Second Witness
programme.desc: Lucas puts his life in jeopardy when he agrees to testify in a murder case where the first witness was killed before he could testify, and the killer is still at large.

programme.title: The Trade
programme.desc: Outlaw Sam Morley falls in love with an ill woman and asks Lucas to turn him in for the reward money.

programme.title: One Went to Denver
programme.desc: Lucas welcomes his old friend Tom Birch, unaware that the man is now a bank robber on the run with his gang.

programme.title: The Deadly Wait
programme.desc: Dan Maury, released from Yuma prison, arrives in North Fork intent on getting even with Marshal Torrance, who helped send him to jail.

programme.title: The Wrong Man
programme.desc: Mark McCain is eager to help lawman Jay Jefferson, who has arrived in town to kill an outlaw for the reward.

programme.title: The Challenge
programme.desc: Lucas comes to the rescue when escaped convicts hold up the general store in North Fork and take Marshall Torrance hostage.

programme.title: The Hawk
programme.desc: Young Mark manages to capture a hawk but falls into danger with a rattlesnake. A stranger comes to his rescue and Mark invites the man home, unaware that he is on the run from the law.

programme.title: Three-Legged Terror
programme.desc: Lucas takes in an orphaned teen being raised by his abusive uncle after there is trouble at the school.

programme.title: The Angry Man
programme.desc: The McCains try to be tolerant of their embittered neighbor Abel MacDonald, but they decide he's gone too far when he won't allow his injured boy to get medical treatment.

programme.title: The Woman
programme.desc: An unfounded rumor causes North Fork's outspoken feminist schoolteacher to be attacked by a mob of angry townspeople.

programme.title: The Money Gun
programme.desc: When his employer begins to suspect him of embezzlement, Asa Manning decides to hire a professional gunman.

programme.title: A Matter of Faith
programme.desc: A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project, but executives are afraid workers will desert them if they believe an old man's claim of making rain.

programme.title: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Lucas McCain gives blood to save a dying man and is surprised by Marshall Torrance's odd behavior towards him. Soon, men arrive from a nearby town and demand custody of the man.

programme.title: Stranger at Night
programme.desc: When Mark finds of the body of a murder victim, Lucas, his friend Artemus and Marshall Torrance begin a search for the killer.

programme.title: The Raid
programme.desc: When renegade Apaches wound Lucas, Marshall Torrance joins with a U.S. Marshall to form a rescue posse.

programme.title: Outlaw's Inheritance
programme.desc: Lucas is the town's representative to the railroad commission until an infamous train robber dies and leaves his ill-gotten wealth to Lucas. Lucas must clear his name.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: When a rancher dies after the bank forecloses the mortgage on his property, his son blames the banker for his father's death.

programme.title: The Mind Reader
programme.desc: When a wealthy rancher is killed, Mark suggests that they ask a mind reader to identify the murderer.

programme.title: The Patsy
programme.desc: A group of outlaws devise a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.

programme.title: Bloodlines
programme.desc: After Lucas kills a mountain man in a brawl, his father arrives in North Fork to break his other boys out of jail and take revenge on Lucas and Marshall Torrance.

programme.title: The Blowout
programme.desc: Newly arrived gunslinger Al Walker throws a mammoth party at the saloon, keeping acting Marshall Ben Waller busy until Lucas is forced to intervene.

programme.title: Obituary
programme.desc: After Lucas accuses a newspaper writer's misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death, the writer begins writing articles about Lucas.

programme.title: Tension
programme.desc: Gavin and Ezra Martin think that Lucas killed their son Clemmie while taking part in a train robbery and Lucas refuses to tell them what really happened.

programme.title: Eddie's Daughter
programme.desc: Eddie's daughter causes trouble for Lucas when two strangers threaten her life after she arrives with criminal information and stolen money.

programme.title: Panic
programme.desc: Brett Conway blackmails Lucas with the knowledge that a couple Lucas rescued is suffering from yellow fever.

programme.title: Ordeal
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark arae stranded in the middle of a desert with very little food or water, and after Lucas is injured, Mark becomes the only hope for their survival.

programme.title: Spiked Rifle
programme.desc: While trying to protect Banker Hamilton's gold, Mark is kidnapped and held hostage at the McCain ranch and will be killed within the hour unless Lucas cooperates.

programme.title: Letter of the Law
programme.desc: Lucas makes a life-or-death decision when Micah is held hostage and the kidnappers demand the release of a notorious outlaw.

programme.title: Legacy
programme.desc: Lucas tries to do a good deed for the old town drunk but it backfires when the drunk's son believes he inherited Lucas' ranch.

programme.title: The Baby Sitter
programme.desc: A dance hall singer asks Lucas to care for her daughter in an effort to hide the baby from her self-righteous, bigoted father.

programme.title: The Coward
programme.desc: Lucas becomes involved in a battle between an aspiring writer and a cocky, bragging trail boss.

programme.title: Surveyors
programme.desc: Mark runs away from home after his father questions his story about overhearing a plot to rob the bank.

programme.title: Day of the Hunter
programme.desc: A famous buffalo hunter tries to goad Lucas into a shooting match. When Lucas refuses, he becomes the target.

programme.title: Mail Order Groom
programme.desc: When a stranger arrives to marry the town spinster, two brothers who want her land try to discourage him with threats and a beating.

programme.title: A Case of Identity
programme.desc: Mark finds himself in grave danger when two unscrupulous detectives searching for a man's long-lost son claim that it's Mark.

programme.title: The Visitor
programme.desc: Lucas is drawn to a young widow passing through town on her way to claim an inheritance but others who covet it are trying to kill her.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: After a young stablehand kills a notorious gunslinger, he is baffled by the hostility of the townspeople about giving him the reward.

programme.title: The Horse Traders
programme.desc: When a horse dealer transporting a prize stallion stops in North Fork, two saddle tramps try to steal it.

programme.title: The Spoiler
programme.desc: An elderly couple moves to town under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a killer.

programme.title: Heller
programme.desc: After foiling a girl's attempt to rob a store, Lucas finds that she is planning to kill her stepfather.

programme.title: The Grasshopper
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark find themselves held at gunpoint by a prisoner being transported on a train, which becomes stranded from a plague of grasshoppers.

programme.title: A Time For Singing
programme.desc: Mark discovers that the new preacher and his wife are impostors planning a robbery.

programme.title: The Deserter
programme.desc: Lucas and Marshall Torrance get into trouble with the Army when they try to help a wounded young soldier who deserted.

programme.title: The Vision
programme.desc: After Mark contracts typhoid fever and has a vision of his dead mother he no longer seems interested in getting well.

programme.title: Lariat
programme.desc: An old friend of Lucas's returns to town in the company of a shady gambler and is accused of cheating at cards.

programme.title: Smoke Screen
programme.desc: Several men are vying for a prosperous rancher's daughter's affections. When she is found dead, one of them becomes the prime suspect in her murder.

programme.title: Shotgun Man
programme.desc: Lucas receives a series of mysterious threatening notes from an ex-convict with a grudge.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: After shooting a man in self-defense, Andy Moon turns to Lucas for protection from the man's brothers.

programme.title: The Prodigal
programme.desc: To keep his invalid mother happy, an outlaw forces Lucas and Mark to go along with a masquerade that he is the owner of Lucas's ranch.

programme.title: The Fourflusher
programme.desc: A sharecropper enters his colt in a horse race hoping to win enough money to buy his farm from the owner who has bet on Mark McCain's entry.

programme.title: The Jailbird
programme.desc: When Lucas hires an ex-con as a ranch hand, the man is the first under suspicion when a murder occurs in town.

programme.title: Meeting at Midnight
programme.desc: Lucas helps his former Army captain, now an undercover federal agent, infiltrate a gang of bank robbers.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Lucas finds himself involved in murder when he gallantly steps to the aid of a beautiful woman.

programme.title: The Hangman
programme.desc: An ex-convict is blamed for a brutal crime despite his claims of rehabilitation.

programme.title: Trail of Hate
programme.desc: Lucas is out for vengeance when Mark is used as a pawn in a bank robbery scheme.

programme.title: Woman from Hog Ridge
programme.desc: Lucas shoots a horse thief who turns out to be a member of the Boyle clan. Now Ma Boyle is after him.

programme.title: Seven
programme.desc: Seven condemned murderers escape and take over the town of North Fork.

programme.title: The Pitchman
programme.desc: When Mark finds gold on their property, a fast-talking salesman who tried to sell Lucas a new lightning rod offers instead to buy the ranch's mineral rights.

programme.title: Strange Town
programme.desc: Lucas tracks an escaped prisoner to a town that turns out to be run by the gunman's brother who is notorious for shooting people in the back.

programme.title: A Firefighter Rebuilds
programme.desc: John and Zack head to California's Sonoma County to help volunteer firefighter Scott and his wife, Xanthie, build a home to replace the one they lost in the Northern California wildfires of 2017.

programme.title: 300 Sq. Ft. Crash Pad
programme.desc: A couple plans on turning its garage into a tiny house and renting out its big house to generate extra income.

programme.title: 250 Sq. Ft. World Traveler's Home
programme.desc: Kyle and Whitney have realized they really don't need a lot of stuff to enjoy life and want to build a home to reflect just that.

programme.title: Tiny House Hits the Road
programme.desc: When a Florida couple gives up their huge condo so they can hit the road, John and Zack attempt to build a tiny house where the nocturnal nurse and his sun-loving bride can coexist.

programme.title: 380 Sq. Ft. Derby House
programme.desc: Scott and Marianne both grew up in horse racing towns and have a deep appreciation for the culture that comes with the sport. They ask John and Zack to help create a house that will embody the rustic charm they love but include some high-end gadgets.

programme.title: 320 Sq. Ft. Tiny Arc
programme.desc: David and Conrad are ready to make the move to go tiny, just before they make another move down south to Central Florida.

programme.title: Tiny Forever After
programme.desc: John and Zack take on a rescue mission in Atlanta for Peter and Elizabeth, a couple who are struggling to finish construction on their own tiny house, are about to get married, and plan to change jobs and move to Maine all in a month's time.

programme.desc: John Weisbarth and Zack Giffin will be showing us 12 amazing tiny homes in amazing locations packed with tricks to make each home perfect for the holidays.

programme.desc: Steve and Melissa build a contemporary and colorful home that gives everyone the privacy they'd like while being constrained to less space than what they're used to.

programme.title: Tiny Bachelor Pad in Asheville, NC
programme.desc: Jeff's traveled far and wide, but when he visited Asheville, N.C., he knew he'd found home; after successfully establishing himself as an orthopedic therapist, Jeff's ready to buy his own hunk of Asheville.

programme.desc: Navy Aviator Matt and his wife, Chanell, spend so much of their family time cleaning and maintaining their Victorian home that they can't enjoy the relaxed Pensacola lifestyle; Matt and Chanell decide to take control of their lives by going tiny.

programme.title: Tiny Together in Cleveland
programme.desc: Anthony and Anthony are sick of living in separate pricey apartments on opposite sides of Cleveland, so they're ready to take the next step in their relationship and go tiny together.

programme.title: Going Mini and Metropolitan in Dublin, Ireland
programme.desc: Nine years after settling in Ireland, Tom and Sasha have decided to invest in a second, small house in Dublin; but with three children and artist incomes, they're worried the right tiny home in the center of town may be out of their reach.

programme.title: A House on the Sunshine Coast
programme.desc: This young couple wants to go tiny, but they want a home that's spacious enough to each have their own private space.

programme.title: A Tiny Starter Home in Devon
programme.desc: Anxious to leave the nest, Esther has decided to become a tiny house investor to help fund her dream of becoming a world traveler.

programme.title: Small and Sustainable in Kin Kin Australia
programme.desc: Alanna and Zeb hope to leave big-city Brisbane and move two hours away to small-town Kin Kin, Australia.

programme.title: Petit Chateau in Paris
programme.desc: Shari's looking for a place with plenty of light, in a great location and with some Parisian charm but with her modest budget, she may be looking in the wrong city.

programme.title: Going Tiny and Off the Grid In Australia's Backcountry
programme.desc: Eager to leave the rat race of Sydney behind, Natasha and Lloyd are excited to leave the city and find something off the beaten path; Natasha and Lloyd are on the hunt to go as small and completely off the grid as possible.

programme.title: Going Tiny in the Venice of the North
programme.desc: After spending years in an oversized bachelor pad, Matthew is excited to purchase his first property in Amsterdam. With the help of his boyfriend Vincent, Matthew is eager to find a space they both love.

programme.title: Theatrical Family Seeking Tiny Sanctuary in Yorkshire

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (3/2/77)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (3/30/77)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (2/11/82)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Leonard Nimoy (4/3/91)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Sylvester Stallone (5/2/91)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - George Segal (11/8/91)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (3/12/92)
programme.desc: Whipped cream anyone? Burt Reynolds shows a clip of him squirting whipped cream down Johnny's trousers. Burt then shoves a can in his own pants and sprays his crotch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Lily Tomlin (12/3/75)
programme.desc: Comic actress Lily Tomlin talks about her family's reaction to her one-woman concert and recounts her brother's arrest in Detroit for being in a car with a black woman.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Sylvester Stallone (5/21/82)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Tony Randall (6/21/77)
programme.desc: Felix Unger reborn! TV veteran Tony Randall chats about his new role as a Philadelphia judge on The Tony Randall Show. Also tells Johnny he's quit the booze.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Tony Randall (11/21/79)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Teri Garr (3/25/83)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Susan Sarandon (5/9/74)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Adrienne Barbeau (12/12/74)
programme.desc: Adrienne Barbeau has received some strange Christmas presents! Plus, Johnny interviews Richard Harris and Bob Hope.

programme.title: Montreal
programme.desc: The team finds startling paranormal links to Montreal's boozy, corrupt past in the 1920s and '30s, such as a man whose corpse became an attraction, a woman haunted by ghost children, and a murder victim in a notorious cabaret.

programme.title: Salem
programme.desc: Hunt for the truth in Massachusetts; Salem's ghosts -- including that of the first woman hanged for witchcraft -- reveal things about the city's infamous witch trials; a message from a man executed in the worst way imaginable.

programme.title: Curse of Egypt
programme.desc: A famous inscription leads some to believe that a real curse haunts the original discoverers of Tutankhamun.

programme.title: The Demonic Scratch House

programme.title: Summer of the Saucers

programme.title: The Tall Whites

programme.title: Paul Bennewitz and Project Seven Lambs

programme.title: Rendlesham Forest, Back from the Future

programme.title: The Belgian UFO Wave

programme.title: School's Out for Saucer
programme.desc: On a September morning in 1994, students at a Zimbabwe school witness a silver craft land in a nearby field; numerous adults corroborate the UFO sighting, but the children are silenced; many maintain their account of the incident is true.

programme.title: Negative Energy
programme.desc: Lt. Ryan Graves and pilots in his squadron detect and engage with UFOs on multiple occasions; he gave a detailed description of regular encounters that flight teams had with a black box UFO they were seeing every day.

programme.title: Stigmata
programme.desc: For over 1,000 years, people worldwide claim to develop injuries spontaneously.

programme.title: Dover Demon

programme.title: Hidden Treasure

programme.title: Voynich Manuscript

programme.title: Jimmy Hoffa

programme.title: Duel in the Desert
programme.desc: In the Iraq War, flying in the desert poses unique difficulties - the dust storm that accompanies every landing and take-off - and the lack of places to hide. When a young Royal Navy pilot comes under fire from a tank, he soon finds himself engaged in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Why We Fight
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: America at War: October-December: 1941
programme.desc: As Hitler focussed on Russia, the situation in the Pacific developed to epic proportions when the Japanese air force attacked the American Naval Fleet at Pearl Harbour on the 7th of December. This immediately brought the USA into the Theatre of War.

programme.title: The Fall of Singapore: January-March 1942
programme.desc: With Britain no longer facing Hitler alone, the first GIs arrived in the UK. As Singapore fell, the Allies looked on in horror as Japan also had control of Java, Burma and New Guinea, as they edged ever closer towards Australia.

programme.title: The Battle of Normandy
programme.desc: The Allied landings on D Day and the subsequent battles for control of Normandy.

programme.title: The SS: A Barbaric State
programme.desc: Among the defendants are the Führer's closest surviving accomplices. But not only them: defendant number 27 is not even a man. It is an entire organization: the SS were a state within the state - which ruled all the police - with its own army, within the Nazi regime.

programme.title: Episode Three
programme.desc: This 3-part program concludes with the liberation of the concentration caps and the arrests and trials of the surviving Nazi leaders for war crimes. The end of the Second World War.

programme.title: German Sniper Training
programme.desc: German Sniper Training.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The Fall of France
programme.desc: When Hitler claimed restitution of Sudetenland, France and Britain abandoned their ally. Ignoring offers to help defend the Czechs, French leaders met with Hitler in Munich in Sep. 1938. Hitler performed like a statesmen, and French leaders signed a treaty that was in fact a death warrant for their own countries. Hitler felt that the floodgates were open and the wave became unstoppable.

programme.title: Big Picture: Korean Wind Up 1953
programme.desc: The end of the Korean War and a review of the United Nations that fought against the North.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: 'Black Week' 1943 sees the worst casualties to date with missions bombing ever deeper into Germany. Veterans describe atrocities committed against captured aircrew, and The Mighty 8th set about crushing Nazi industry, preparing for invasion, destroying the Luftwaffe, reaching Berlin, smashing Hitler's Third Reich, and bringing to an end, the greatest conflict the world has ever known.

programme.title: German Armour: The Panzer III
programme.desc: It was Heinz Guderian who in 1934, gave specifications for 2 frontline tanks to be manufactured. The first was intended to be the main battle tank of the Panzer divisions capable of destroying enemy tanks. It was called the Panzer 3. Crewed by 5 men, its weight varied at around 20 tons during the campaign in the west, and achieved a top speed of 25 mph. Its main armament was a 37 mm canon.

programme.title: The Secrets of the Weapons
programme.desc: From snake-infested jungles to treacherous underground tunnel complexes to city streets, U.S. Infantrymen had to fight in all terrains in Vietnam. Superb combat footage records the war as it raged both in the countryside and in the cities of Saigon and Hue during the Tet Offensive of 1968.

programme.title: The Battle of Italy
programme.desc: The conquest of Italy from the Allied invasion through the various battles.

programme.title: The Battle of Berlin: The Russians Are Coming
programme.desc: The advance of the Red Army towards Berlin in the final months of WWII.

programme.title: The Ultimate History of the Messerschmitt
programme.desc: In this program we look at the development of the Bf 109 which flew in all theaters of conflict in which the Luftwaffe was involved. More Bf 109s were built than any other fighter of the era. After the war the Spanish Air Force continued to operate them but powered by the engine of its great wartime adversary the Spitfire's Rolls Royce Merlin. Also featured are the ME 262, Bf110, and ME 169 Komet.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front
programme.desc: Documentary charting the battles waged on the Russian Front in the Second World War. The events which occurred are seen by some as the most barbaric conflict in human history

programme.title: U.X.B. Unexploded Bomb Disposal WWII England
programme.desc: A fascinating British Military Training Film dealing with the reconnaissance, identification, and reporting of unexploded bombs or U.X.B. during WWII. A interesting time capsule showing the horrors or The Blitz.

programme.title: Reinhard Heydrich
programme.desc: His fleet of U-boats killed thousands and sunk millions of tons of ships and supplies. His career spanned the depths of the ocean to the leader of a nation. At Nuremberg he was charged with piracy and murder as a Nazi War Criminal, and yet escaped the hangman. His story is now told, by both the historians and by the personal statements of those who served with him.

programme.title: Triumphant on Land
programme.desc: Speed and strategy have always defined warfare. This episode explores the evolution of battlefield mobility-from chariots and cavalry to Humvees and tanks. Highlighting the most iconic and influential combat vehicles, including WWII's infamous tanks, we reveal how movement has been a decisive force in shaping tactics, winning battles, and revolutionizing modern war logistics.

programme.title: Crossing the Rhine
programme.desc: The Allies cross the Rhine River into Germany in the early part of 1945. The Canadians cross in February, followed by the Americans and British, with the Americans taking Cologne and crossing river at Remagen. Winston Churchill visits the front and crosses the river himself in a landing boat.

programme.title: Episode Three
programme.desc: This 3-part program concludes with the liberation of the concentration caps and the arrests and trials of the surviving Nazi leaders for war crimes. The end of the Second World War.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Lt. Kravtsov, a platoon commander, begins his active duty. The odds are against him, as lieutenants typically have only three days to live. Within this time, he must lead his troops in a futile attack, hoping to save the incoming regiment. Can he survive these three days?

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Amidst enemy forces gathering, a Luftwaffe squadron guards above, raising suspicions of troop relocation. A pilot's sacrifice, underwater tanks, and strategists' debates add to tensions. The mission is to destroy the enemy crossing without battles. Pilots reflect on their future amid potential encirclement and lack of aviation devices.

programme.title: Big Picture: The Korean Ceasefire Talks Begin
programme.desc: This program includes a tribute to the men of the Infantry from an officer who served with them as a platoon leader, Lieutenant Robert Fallon of Washington, D.C. Lieutenant Fallon points out the difficult but important job of the man carrying the rifle in combat. Captain Zimmerman interviews Master Sergeant Heidenreith, also of Washington, D.C. Sergeant Heidenreith was a combat engineer in Korea.

programme.title: Project 949
programme.desc: The mysterious sinking, the causes and the salvage operations are revealed of the K-141, Kursk. The Kursk was a Project 949A submarine of the Oscar-class. During the Cold War, The Soviet Navy had to face the challenge of NATO's powerful maritime fleets. The Soviets then discreetly launched Project 949, a top secret program for the construction of a new generation of missile carrying submarines.

programme.title: FURY IN THE PACIFIC
programme.desc: This documentary covers a pair of World War II battles: the Battle of Peleliu and the Battle of Angaur. It was co-produced by the U.S. Army, U.S. Navy, and the U.S. Marines, and directed by a series of combat cameraman - of whom nine became casualties of the battles they were filming. The film is especially noteworthy for its praise of the fighting abilities of Japanese soldiers.

programme.title: The Battle of Midway and Beyond: April-June 1942
programme.desc: The American Navy got back on course after Pearl Harbour, and in the four-day Battle for the Coral Sea, they claimed victory, before defeating Japan again in the decisive Battle of Midway. Elsewhere the Luftwaffe targeted more British cities.

programme.title: El Alamein to Stalingrad: July-September 1942
programme.desc: Hitler's 'Desert Fox', Rommel advanced at El Alamein, but with the arrival of British General, Bernard Montgomery, to lead the Eighth Army in North Africa, the wind of change was about to blow.

programme.title: Omaha Beach
programme.desc: A German Tank Gunner and an American Infantryman recollect the US landings at Omaha Beach during the D Day Invasion of France.

programme.title: Breakout from Normandy
programme.desc: American and German Supply Chain Personnel look back at the Allied breakout from Normandy in the weeks after D Day.

programme.title: Big Picture: Army Transportation Corps
programme.desc: We follow the supplies from the factory to the depot in the U.S., to the port to the front line unit in Korea. We show the Port of Embarkation, small boats, the ducks, the rail lines, the trucks. And we show a new development of the TC... the helicopter transportation company in training.

programme.title: The Gothic Line
programme.desc: A look at the Battle of the Gothic Line from an American Soldier and a soldier from the German Wehrmacht. Also features bonus footage of the Battle Of The Bulge.

programme.title: Africa: Our First Offensive
programme.desc: The Troops of Operation Torch come from the U.S. and Britain. U.S. industry is shown going to full war production. Equipment is shown being loaded up for transport to North Africa, and the landings are made successfully.

programme.title: Exploring Hitler's Munich
programme.desc: Munich was closely tied to National Socialism, where the Nazi movement, SA, and SS were founded. Hitler called it the 'capital of the movement' and planned grandiose architectural projects. Though most plans weren't realized, landmarks like the 'Haus der Kunst' and parts of the party district still stand today. Rare footage shows Hitler visiting construction sites in Munich's transformed areas.

programme.title: 1940 - Storm Over the Alps
programme.desc: The Alps Front, June 1940. A handful of French soldiers are about to face a flood of 300,000 Italians. Everywhere in France, you see defeat. The Government fled to Bordeaux on June 14th. While France is breaking down, General Olry and his men remain stationed on the Alps. During ten days of fierce battle, the Italians will lose more than 6,000 men without seizing an inch of French territory.

programme.title: Scorched Earth: Propaganda
programme.desc: There are many weapons of war; fighter planes, heavy tanks and skilled infantrymen but it could be argued that none is more powerful than the power of suggestion. Propaganda and the war of words played an undoubtedly vital role in both the successes and failures of WW2. Governments struggled to gain the upper hand. But one Nazi proved to have a deft talent for spin. Joseph Goebbels.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries: 1945
programme.desc: In this final film of the series, '1945', the end of the war is now truly in sight. Yet there were still hurdles to overcome, and with the completion of the Battle of the Bulge still to test the Allies, the race for Berlin was on. Discover what happened in Hitler's final hours and enjoy the VE Day celebrations with Winston Churchill and the people of Britain as the dream of victory became reality.

programme.title: Part 2: War on Hitler
programme.desc: During the war with the Soviet Union, 35mm color footage was used for Nazi propaganda. Hitler's pilot filmed his visit to the front lines. Meanwhile, Hollywood director John Ford captured stunning color scenes in North Africa. A camera crew, sent by President Roosevelt, recorded the 1943 Casablanca Conference, where the Allies demanded the unconditional surrender of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Great Battles of The Civil War: Volume 1
programme.desc: Volume 1 - 1861-1863. This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1861-1863. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: The Stuka
programme.desc: From the moment of the Germany invasion of Poland in 1940, to the downfall of the Third Reich in 1945, one plane was synonymous with the terror and destruction caused by the Luftwaffe during WW2. The infamous Yunkers U87, a dive bomber. There were other dive bombers, but only the U87 was known by the British as and feared, named by the abbreviation - The Stuka.

programme.title: Hitler's Big Guns
programme.desc: Ground-breaking 3D graphics and state-of-the-art computer animation provide some of the highlights in this authoritative, entertaining look at the great German siege guns of World War Two. The programme features extraordinary archive footage culled from German and Allied sources and all-new footage of surviving examples of German heavy artillery.

programme.title: Animals at War: Wild Heroes of World War II
programme.desc: Fifty million people died in the WWII, the biggest massacre in the history of humanity. But the animal kingdom also paid a heavy toll, despite no official numbers being compiled for the victims. This included combat animals, animals that backed up humans, those that entertained or consoled them, some that fed people, and other animals that were symbols.

programme.title: Triumphant on Land
programme.desc: Speed and strategy have always defined warfare. This episode explores the evolution of battlefield mobility-from chariots and cavalry to Humvees and tanks. Highlighting the most iconic and influential combat vehicles, including WWII's infamous tanks, we reveal how movement has been a decisive force in shaping tactics, winning battles, and revolutionizing modern war logistics.

programme.title: Air Defense & Surveillance - Helicopters
programme.desc: In the early 1480s, Leonardo Da Vinci designed an aerial screw. Its intended use was unknown, yet served as the inspiration for the helicopter. Developments over the years have seen the Helicopter becoming more involved in troop transport, including airlifting the wounded directly to hospitals. Today's attack Helicopters show the versatility of this war machine.

programme.title: Hitler's Favourite Royal
programme.desc: Prince Charles Edward was Queen Victoria's youngest grandchild. Brought up at Claremont House and educated at Eton until he was 14, Charles Edward was forced by Queen Victoria to take up the Dukedom of Coburg in Germany after a series of unexpected deaths of uncles and cousins. Transformed overnight from a British Prince to a German Duke, his life was altered in ways he could never have imagined.

programme.title: The Tide Turns: 1943 - 1944
programme.desc: Stalingrad breaks the Nazi advance; Japan falters at Guadalcanal. The tide begins to turn. Mussolini falls as Allies land in Sicily. The Soviets crush Germany at Kursk. Allied tech improves-radar, codebreaking, bombing raids. War spreads into the skies. In Tehran, Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin prepare for D-Day. The drive to defeat fascism gathers momentum.

programme.title: Waking a Sleeping Giant
programme.desc: The 1930's bring remarkable advances in military flight and provide Germany and Japan with decisive advantages in the air as World War II begins. The Germans pound London in the Battle of the Blitz while Japanese naval aviation brings the United States into the war with the attack on Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Reconnaissance Aircraft
programme.desc: Reconnaissance aircraft play a significant role in both war and peace time. This program looks at several planes that were deployed in this crucial activity including the RA-5C, the Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird, PC3 Orion and the Grumman E-2 Hawkeye.

programme.title: The Air War on Japan
programme.desc: An in-depth look at the air war over Japan during WWII, including the Doolittle Raid, B-29 attacks, and the nuclear bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front
programme.desc: Documentary charting the battles waged on the Russian Front in the Second World War. The events which occurred are seen by some as the most barbaric conflict in human history

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Lt. Kravtsov, a platoon commander, begins his active duty. The odds are against him, as lieutenants typically have only three days to live. Within this time, he must lead his troops in a futile attack, hoping to save the incoming regiment. Can he survive these three days?

programme.title: The Tide Begins to Turn: October-December 1942
programme.desc: As 1942 drew to a close, the Allies were really beginning to make headway. The British made a crucial breakthrough in North Africa, and the Americans pushed the Japanese out of Burma and New Guinea. In Russia the Germans found themselves surrounded.

programme.title: Facing the Music: January-March 1943
programme.desc: The only option for the German Sixth Army at Stalingrad was surrender, while all across Russia the Red Army consolidated their advantage. Also, as German cities encountered the kind of bombing that Britain faced back in 1940, courtesy of the RAF.

programme.title: D-Day
programme.desc: The landings on the beaches of Normandy, the first step in the operation, codenamed Overlord enterprise by Dwight D. Eisenhower. The greatest amphibious invasion in history.

programme.title: U-Boat Alert!
programme.desc: World War II at sea was marked by the rise of submarines, leading to fierce battles above and below the waves. Crews faced overcrowding and claustrophobia in these confined spaces. This technological evolution paved the way for modern submarines. Developed by Germany, submarines became as crucial to naval warfare as strategic bombers were to the skies, with other countries soon following suit.

programme.title: Death in Snow and Sand
programme.desc: The third episode opens with Rommel's second offensive in North Africa. The following summer the German offensive at Kharkov and the subsequent push past the River Don towards Volga and Stalingrad, later the scene of Germany's first major defeat - The Battle of Stalingrad. The scene is switched to North Africa following the continuous battle between the British 8th Army, the Desert Rats.

programme.title: Vichy and the Nazis: A Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: 1942: Almost 80,000 French Jews are arrested, following the orders of Adolf Hitler and Vichy. From the Vel' d'Hiv Roundup to Auschwitz, thanks to the most recent historiography and reenactment, plunge into the making of the Holocaust.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: For nearly five years, Hitler's Third Reich has dominated Europe. Germany braces for an Allied invasion, fortifying the Atlantic Wall with steel, concrete, and advanced weaponry. Led by the USA, a global alliance faces overwhelming odds, launching a massive military assault to break Germany's grip on Western Europe and reclaim freedom from Nazi control.

programme.title: Rough Riders
programme.desc: Speeding behind German lines the men of Troop A, in their armored cars and half-tracks left destruction and fear in their wake. Surprising the German garrison at the town of Epernay, they established an outpost from which they could defend a counter-attack. Outnumbered and outgunned with thirteen rounds of ammunition left, these brave GI's held this vital town until re-enforcements could arrive.

programme.title: The Dawns Here are Quiet (English Version)
programme.desc: It is late spring of 1942, and World War 2 is in full swing. A long way off from the front-line the Germans make an air landing operation in an attempt to get through to the Kirov railway and the White Sea - Baltic Sea Canal. The only obstacle in their way is an anti-aircraft artillery unit of corporal Vaskov and five young women in training.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: May 1945: At last the Nazi shadow is lifting...War has devastated the continent, and now everyone just wants to get back to living again... But though the guns are now quiet, the Second World War isn't over yet. The Third Reich may have surrendered but the violence just won't seem to end.

programme.title: Adolf and Eva
programme.desc: The protracted romance between Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun began in 1929 and ended in 1945 in the bunker under the ruins of the Chancellery. Eva was Hitler's bride for less than 40 hours before she committed suicide.

programme.title: Carey Mulligan
programme.desc: Carey Mulligan's grandfather Denzil Booth, travelled thousands of miles to fight the Japanese in the final months of the war. His university education meant Denzil was fast-tracked to be a junior officer in the Navy. He lost his closest friends on board the first ever ship to be attacked by a Japanese Kamikaze. Carey travels to Japan to understand the culture of the Kamikaze from the other side.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Amidst WWII's war-torn skies, Soviet Major Bestuzhev defends the airdrome. A bond forms with comrade Zhenya, but facing overwhelming odds, they must protect their homeland, confronting fears in a narrative of sacrifice, courage, and camaraderie. As the air raid sirens wail, they delve deeper into the turmoil of war, discovering the true essence of duty and the resilience of the human spirit.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Russia In Afghanistan
programme.desc: In 1979, the Soviets had ill-suited uniforms and inferior fighting tactics, and found it impossible to defeat the popular Afghan guerrilla army. They had underestimated their enemy and lacked the forces to win.

programme.title: Big Picture: Atrocities in Korea
programme.desc: A documented report of Communist atrocities in Korea, with scenes just released depicting the horror and brutality of Communism. Includes interviews with returned prisoners of war who were eye witnesses to some of these atrocities and Major General William Dean and General Mark W. Clark.

programme.title: This is Korea
programme.desc: Covers the United States involvement with Korea and testing of Korean weapons. John Ford directed this film which is the only color documentary made during the Korean War.

programme.title: Kristin Scott Thomas
programme.desc: Kristin Scott Thomas's grandfather William served as a Commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout WW2. He survived some of the most devastating battles from Dunkirk to D-Day but never spoke about his experiences. For the first time, Kristin uncovers how he saved thousands at Dunkirk and endured the horrors of the Russian Artic convoys. Kristin's journey is packed with revelation and emotion.

programme.title: The Phoney War
programme.desc: Japan unprovoked invasion had plunged China into war and Europe had been brought to the brink of conflict. In Italy Mussolini introduced fascism to the political landscape and Hitler dismantled democracy. Their expansion threatened neighboring nations.

programme.title: Duel in the Desert
programme.desc: In the Iraq War, flying in the desert poses unique difficulties - the dust storm that accompanies every landing and take-off - and the lack of places to hide. When a young Royal Navy pilot comes under fire from a tank, he soon finds himself engaged in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Hidden Inhabitants of Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet's most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth's biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet's temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Winter Time
programme.desc: Winter is the toughest test that all the Mediterranean forest's inhabitants have to pass. At that time of the year, we can see fully that life will find a way forward even in the worst circumstances.

programme.title: Desert Isle: Manhattan Style
programme.desc: Cissy is babysit the twins, when her boyfriend calls and asks her to go on a trip. She calls someone else to take her place and leaves. The replacement does not get there because of a blizzard.

programme.title: Eastward Ho
programme.desc: Bill offers to let Ming Lee stay at his place. Ming Lee is engaged in an arranged marriage to Bill's friend Eng Ho. Cissy and Gregg take Ming Lee out. She meets someone and refuses to marry Eng Ho.

programme.title: Meet Emily
programme.desc: Bill decides to hire a female employee to help around the house and soften the edges of Mr. French's stiffness. It takes a while, but soon the whole family enjoys having Emily around.

programme.title: All Around the Town
programme.desc: Due to a miscommunication of who would watch Buffy and Jody, the twins find themselves all alone in New York City.

programme.title: One for the Little Boy
programme.desc: Giles French leaves town for a month, so his brother Niles comes to help with the Davis'. Jody is tired of always being around the girls and having to do the things they want to do.

programme.title: I'd Tell You I Love You but We're Not Speaking
programme.desc: When all channels of communication break down between the Hubbards and Buells, a family-style group therapy session is conducted by Jerry's psychology professor.

programme.title: Herb's Little Helpers
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye turn Herb's office into a model of inefficiency when they take over for his sick secretary.

programme.title: Bye, Bye, Blackmailer
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye try diplomacy and artful deception to prevent a blow-up over Herb's $100 loan to Roger, which is due and which Roger can't repay.

programme.title: The Wig Story
programme.desc: Kaye borrows a blonde wig from Eve, and Roger's romantic reaction succeeds only in depressing Kaye, who's convinced that he now prefers blondes.

programme.title: It's Only Money
programme.desc: Tired of Roger's skinflint ways, Herb plots to play golf and gin rummy for money, but Herb finds himself in the financial hole when Roger's luck turns for the better.

programme.title: I Haven't Got a Secret
programme.desc: Kaye gets a game of charades under way to let everyone in on a secret that she isn't allowed to divulge: Roger's scripts are being considered for a TV series.

programme.title: Jerry's Night out with the Boys
programme.desc: The men side with Jerry's decision to play poker with the guys, so the women plan an all-girl night out for Suzie.

programme.title: The Long, Long Weekend
programme.desc: The Hubbards, Buells, and newlyweds each have secret plans for a weekend away from each other. But it backfires: They all head for the same mountain cabin, where snowstorm traps them together.

programme.title: Jealousy Makes the Heart Grow Fonder
programme.desc: Thanks to Kaye's overactive imagination, Eve suspects a rekindled romance between Herb and his old flame, who has come to visit.

programme.title: How Not to Manage a Rock Group
programme.desc: Jerry convinces his folks to put up $500 for a hippie rock group to make a demo recording. They scare off the band with talk of crew cuts, tuxedos, and old songs.

programme.title: The Return of Maudie
programme.desc: A former friend of Mr. French's visits.

programme.title: It Can't Be Five Years
programme.desc: Cissy, Jody and Buffy talk about when they first came to live with their Uncle Bill and realize it has been five years. They decide to throw a party but Bill almost misses it due to work.

programme.title: Travels with Cissy
programme.desc: Love goes awry when Bill tries to stop Cissy from marrying Gregg. Bill takes Cissy to a party to distract her. Cissy meets a man named Steve and realizes she is not in love with Gregg.

programme.title: Stamp of Approval
programme.desc: Bill and Jody try to get on the good side of female friends in order to get something they want. Bill wants a job at her company, and Jody wants a stamp for his collection.

programme.title: And Baby Makes Eight
programme.desc: Cissy's friend Kathy is pregnant, and her husband is out of town.

programme.title: Say Uncle
programme.desc: Jody and a classmate taunt each other with claims of "my father can beat your father," but the parents refuse to fight each other.

programme.title: Class Clown
programme.desc: Laughter is the best medicine but not for every date. Bill goes out with a female comedian who seems to always be performing her act.

programme.title: The Unsinkable Mr. French
programme.desc: Everything at the Davis' place seems to be in a state of chaos, but Mr. French manages to keep things under control. That is, until one more thing goes wrong.

programme.title: Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: The family goes on vacation to Indiana, where Cissy, Buffy, and Jody grew up. Bill wants them to touch base with the relatives still living there and to see their hometown.

programme.title: Feat of Clay
programme.desc: Buffy and Jody accidentally break a small statue originally from Columbia and try to fix it before Uncle Bill finds out about it.

programme.title: Heroes Are Born
programme.desc: Jody's newest hero figure is a football superstar who is Uncle Ken to one of Jody's friend. When Jody finds out that Ken is suspended from the team for placing bets, Jody is disillusioned.

programme.title: Nobody Here But Us Uncles
programme.desc: The twins play matchmaker for Uncle Bill so he has someone in his life when they get older and move out.

programme.title: Too Late, Too Soon
programme.desc: Emily Turner plays matchmaker to Mr French and Miss Faversham, while being the match-breaker for her son Jim Turner and Cissy's relationship.

programme.title: The Littlest Exile
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody make a new friend with Johnnie. Johnnie and his mother are hiding from militants who are interested in finding their father.

programme.title: Put Your Dreams Away
programme.desc: Russ Brook is a former friend of Cissy's who is now in the Peace Corps. Russ asks Cissy to join him on a mission to Chile.

programme.title: The Joiners
programme.desc: Buffy wants to join a popular group at school, but the group does not think she is right for them.

programme.title: Cinder-Emily
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy decide to help Emily go to her son Jim's graduation celebration. She wants a new outfit and someone to take her.

programme.title: Goodbye, Mrs. Beasley
programme.desc: One of Buffy's friends tells her it is time to give up her doll, Mrs. Beasley, as it is a child's toy. They go to a toy store where the owner looks like Mrs. Beasley.

programme.title: Buffy's Fair Lady
programme.desc: Buffy helps a shy friend meet new friends. Buffy throws a party for Angela and friends, but she experiences some unexpected results.

programme.title: You Can't Fight City Hall
programme.desc: Buffy, Jody, and their friend Ricky find a great place to play in the neighborhood. Then they find out a parking lot is going to be built in the space.

programme.title: Buffy
programme.desc: Bill Davis is ambivalent about taking on the responsibility of raising his niece Buffy after the death of his brother. After suggesting she attend boarding school in Switzerland, she runs away.

programme.title: Jody and Cissy
programme.desc: Jody, Buffy's twin brother, and Cissy arrive while Bill is away. When he returns, he must make a decision as to what to do that would be best for the children.

programme.title: The Gift Horse
programme.desc: When Bill returns from Africa bearing gifts, Cissy presents him with a hand-knitted tie. Buffy and Jody also want to give Bill a gift, and purchase a horse for him from a retiring carriage driver.

programme.title: The Matter of School
programme.desc: Bill decides to send Cissy to a private girls' school in Connecticut, and even though she would prefer to attend high school locally, she reluctantly agrees to go.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: An acquaintance of Bill's hires Mr. French to appear in an ad for marmalade that her advertising company is promoting.

programme.title: Room with a Viewpoint
programme.desc: When Bill arranges for an interior decorator to redo Cissy's and Buffy's bedroom, Buffy becomes withdrawn as the changes seem to separate the room and she fears Cissy is separating from her.

programme.title: Mrs. Beasley, Where Are You?
programme.desc: Buffy leaves Mrs. Beasley with Mr. French, who accidentally knocks the doll off the terrace. When Bill learns from Cissy the importance of Mrs. Beasley to Buffy, he goes on a hunt to find the doll.

programme.title: Who's Afraid of Nural Shpeni?
programme.desc: The owner of a Middle East Delicacies store, upon learning Mr. French is unmarried and knowing he is wealthy, introduces him to his cousin, Nural Shpeni, who he and her brothers want Nural to marry.

programme.title: A Matter for Experts
programme.desc: The vice principal and a child psychologist are concerned that Buffy and Jody only spend time with each other instead of playing with the other children.

programme.title: Beware the Other Woman
programme.desc: Cissy thinks Bill is planning to get married to an old friend, but when her new friend tells her how her stepmothers sent her away, Cissy then suspects that the woman will send them away.

programme.title: Take Two Aspirin
programme.desc: Restless, Bill takes a job in the Yutacan, but then starts to miss the family. It gets worse when he is led to believe, through miscommunication by phone, that Mr. French has the flu.

programme.title: Love Me, Love Me Not

Can Judge Faith Jenkins provide this couple one last lifeline or will this relationship go to the dogs?

programme.desc: Antonett says she's tired of Miguel bailing out on their relationship when things get tough. She says Miguel acts like he's single, pawns all their belongings, and constantly accusing her of cheating and claiming their two-year-old son isn't his child. Miguel says he has every right to demand a DNA test on Antonett's son. He claims he's constantly finding her talking to other men and even kissing other women. Will Judge Faith be able to get them to control their reckless love?

"Tosha" says it's "Freddy's" refusal to be intimate with her that has caused their marriage to fall apart. "Freddy" says he's tired of "Tosha's" excuses for stepping out with other men and needs her to understand what she did isn't okay. Can Judge Faith help mend these two broken hearts or is this relationship already lost?

programme.title: Ebony Strothers vs. Kenneth Walker
programme.desc: Ebony is fed up with Kenneth acting like a man who is single! Ebony says Kenneth is constantly blaming "work" for the reason he's not around and hanging out with other women. Kenneth says he's tired of constantly trying to prove his innocence and says their relationship would thrive if Ebony would stop snooping around. Can Judge Faith perform some magic and resolve this messy quarrel?

programme.title: Kayla Anderson vs. Antione Anderson
programme.desc: Kayla says Antione has failed to provide for their family and abandoned them multiple times. She's willing to give him a second chance but needs him to prove that he can be a reliable partner and financial provider to their family, and quit bailing out whenever another woman gives him attention. Antione says Kayla needs to be more patient and stop flying off the handle every time there's a disagreement between them. Can Judge Faith save this hurting marriage?

programme.title: April Walls vs. Keith Walls
programme.desc: April says she wants her husband, Keith, to come clean once and for all. She says he's never been honest about how he sees other women on the side. She also claims he's an alcoholic who's not financially responsible. Keith argues April not only nags about every little thing but also wants to lead the marriage and be the man in the relationship. He says if she would let him be the man in their marriage, they could live a much happier life.

programme.title: Mavia Clemon vs. Lenoris "Lee" Starks
programme.desc: Mavia says "Lee's" controlling ways are keeping them from being truly happy. She claims he refuses to let her buy her own clothes, constantly makes her feel inferior, and must always know where she's at. "Lee" says if Mavia wants this relationship to work, she needs to be more submissive. Can this over-controlled relationship be salvaged?

programme.title: Janeil Munoz vs. Rico Williams
programme.desc: Janeil says she's tired of being the breadwinner and the only one in her relationship to take commitment seriously. She says Rico is a lazy cheater, who needs to either step up or leave her alone once and for all. Rico says Janiel is a drama queen who's too easily influenced by outside voices and needs to stop listening to other people. Does Judge Faith have what it takes to save this couple or is this relationship doomed?

programme.title: Nicole Borden vs. Antonio Borden (Part 1)
programme.desc: After 14 years of marriage, Nicole says she's come to Divorce Court to get her life back! She says her husband, Antonio, is a serial cheater who had multiple children outside of their marriage and she no longer wishes to continue being with him. Antonio admits to his mistakes in the past but wants to save his marriage and needs Nicole to hear him out one last time. Is it possible for this marriage to be saved?

programme.title: Nicole Borden vs. Antonio Borden (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 14 years of marriage, Nicole says she's come to Divorce Court to get her life back! Is Judge Faith willing to bet on this couple or is it time to for them to fold and walk away?

programme.title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: New Year Blues
programme.desc: 4 different couples spend 1 romantic week over New Year's Eve. Both coming out of failed marriages Ji-ho and Hyo-young are not open for the possibilities of new love. Yong-chan and Yaolin are an international couple soon to get married but their already-growing marriage blues begin to get worse as Yong- chan is swindled out of his wedding savings.

programme.title: The Throne
programme.desc: In the year of 1762 when King Yeong Jo of the Joseon dynasty's been ruling for 35 years already Crown prince Sa Do is accused of plotting treason by his biological mother lady Yi. King Yeong Jo falls into a dilemma since he could not penalize his own son as a traitor as it would mean that he would become the father of a traitor threatening his throne and ends up ordering Sa Do to take his own life.

programme.desc: Suk-jung's devotion to Eun-ha leads him to search for her after her past and HIV force her to leave him.

programme.title: My Little Brother
programme.desc: Three siblings must figure out what to do with a younger brother whom they were suddenly introduced to and did not know even existed before.

programme.title: Episode 15

programme.title: Episode 16

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Mi-rae shows her new face to her father; at school, she attracts the attention of students including Do Kyeong-seok, who knows about her past.

programme.desc: A seductive thief and a relentless cop clash in a tense game of love and duty in a dangerous criminal world.

programme.title: Hostage: Missing Celebrity

programme.desc: "Something strange is happening here at Gwanglim mansion." Ji-woo a webtoon artist visits a small and deserted mansion located outside of Seoul to gather an idea for his work. But while he is searching the area he listens to suspicious stories from the manager. A stray pair of shoes which are far off from the corridor a giggling sound of laughter from invisible children... Despite of spooky atmosphere which sneaks in Ji-woo he unconsciously goes deeper into that strange mansion.

programme.title: Miracle in Cell No.7

programme.title: Homme Fatale

programme.title: Episode 6
