programme.title: Deadly Snail vs Kung Fu Killer
programme.desc: In this kung fu fantasy, a daring duel of powers between the fairies, finds the young mortal Cheung rescuing the Sky Mussel Fairy. His bravery is not repaid, however, as Cheung is driven out of his home by his uncle. Now, Cheung must struggle to stay alive in a world of gods and demons, with only his kung fu powers to keep him safe.

programme.title: Top Fighter
programme.desc: Top Fighter with spectacular footage exposes the secrets of Bruce Lee's jeet kune do. Jackie Chan explains the rigors of his daily training and Jet Li demonstrates the Wu Shu skills that made him national champion and international superstar

programme.title: Eagle Claw vs Butterfly Palm
programme.desc: The great Lo Lieh (Five Fingers of Death) leads an all-star cast in this renowned kung fu classic! Having already destroyed Shaolin and Wu Tang, the feared Butterfly clan now sets their eyes on wiping out all other clans that are in their way. Only a few noble Wu Shu knights are brave enough to face the villains and fight the enemies.

programme.title: The Deadly Fists
programme.desc: A mountain girl Chie finds her father mortally injured by the roadside, and in his dying last breath he names a mysterious stranger, Yuan. She sets out in search to find Yuan, and decides to go to the Shaolin Master, who advises and instructs her to go and meet a rich Lord who might have knowledge of the killer's whereabouts. However, he too seeks Yuan, and fearing competition, he tries to kill her. Who is this stranger, that all are seeking to find him?

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 1
programme.desc: The lone wolf received an assassination request to avenge a clan on the brink of being abolished. The plot thickens as they got caught in a scheme full of betrayals and deceit while being pursued relentlessly by the Yagyu clan.

programme.title: Massive
programme.desc: A martial arts super sleuth is sent to investigate a string of vicious robberies carried out by a man only known as "the jade dragonfly". A who's who of kung fu stars pit their skills and wits against each other in this classic kung fu masterpiece from director Wu Ma.

programme.title: Fatal Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: A crazed martial artist who kills with his flying guillotine wreaks havoc on the martial world. The main character is a swordsman whose mother is ill, and to get the medicine, he must pass 3 tests, which gets him caught up in the guillotine affair.

programme.title: Guards of Shaolin aka Ninja vs Shaolin Guards
programme.desc: A troop of monks from the Shaolin Temple embark on a mission to get the Golden Sutra to Tibet after the Shaolin Abbot is killed by their traitorous teacher. They are joined on their quest by a beautiful, female warrior - with aims to avenge her father's death. They traverse forests and mountains on their mission, all the while fighting off deadly ninja assassins, vicious gangsters and even the undead.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Douglas Wong
programme.desc: Wong is the founder of the modern-day White Lotus system of kung fu. He has traveled the world teaching his art through seminars, training camps, instructional videos, and more. Involved in the martial arts for over 50 years, he has studied under several great teachers, including Ark Y. Wong, the "father of kung fu in America". In the 1970s, he changed history by introducing kung fu into the tournament circuit and developing the most creative demonstration team of that era.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Ernie Reyes
programme.desc: This unique documentary reveals the life of pioneer Ernie Reyes. Raised in poverty and prejudice, he was able to persevere. Through decades of vigorous training, he became one of the top nationally rated competitors in both forms and fighting. He is the chief instructor and co-founder of one of the biggest and most successful schools in the world, the West Coast World Martial Arts.

programme.title: The Clutch of Power
programme.desc: A swordsman known as "Soul of the Sword" has been hired by the Mongolian General to wipe out any Chinese patriots who stand in the way of the Mongol invasion. Leung Kar-Yan comes of best with his lethal spear blade which he uses with great dexterity.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 16
programme.desc: A woman beseeches a man to carryout the revenge he was ordered to do, but a new woman in his life refuses to let him go back to his old ways. Our group of travelers get pulled into the affair during their journeys.

programme.title: Along Comes a Tiger aka Along Comes the Tiger
programme.desc: Wang Tao, Tommy Lee and Philip Ko. Miracle Man arrives in a sleepy town controlled by The Black Dragon gang. Miracle Man elimintes the key members of the gang in a wave of violent and bloody fights.

programme.title: Legendary Strike
programme.desc: The plot deals with a search for a valuable pearl, dubbed the Buddha's Relic, which is sold to an unwitting Japanese emissary by a corrupt Ching Dynasty prince who seeks to steal it back for his own purposes.

programme.title: King of Darts
programme.desc: Tom a British businessman is an opium smuggler in the early years of the Republic of China; the King of Darts Wang Zha Xi uses all his daring skill to put an end to Tom's dastardly trade.

programme.title: One Shot, One Life
programme.desc: In traditional martial arts, mastery of the art is not acquired through technical skill alone. In following 'The Way' one must look beyond technique to become a true master. In Japanese archery or Kyudo, hitting the target by itself is not enough. To shoot correctly we are told to "Shoot from the Heart". As Takeuchi sensei says "As a national team member I had to hit the target no matter what. Eventually all that technique became obsolete in exchange to express myself through the bow".

programme.title: Green Jade Statuette
programme.desc: A band of criminal's returns to a vice-filled village one year after their theft of a valuable family artifact, along with a talented fighter hired to recover the relic. Top-notch old-school shapes from the team that brought you "Eagles Claw".

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 2
programme.desc: While continuing on their separate journeys, the Lethal Three run into each other again along with a woman they previously helped. There is something suspicious going on involving a local lord though. Will the ronin, samurai, and ninja get involved to help?

programme.title: End of the Wicked Tigers
programme.desc: Hong Kong action superstar Samo Hung helped choreograph and he co-stars in this High Noon-like tale of courage and corruption. In the early 20th century, a crime lord (Han Ying Chieh) has a small town under his thumb until a new police captain arrives to put things in order. Only one brave witness, Ma San (Charles Heung), is willing to help fight against the impossible odds. An array of spectacular fight scenes dominates.

programme.title: Rings Untouchable
programme.desc: Two kickboxers become embroiled in a world of performance-enhancing drugs and ruthless gang-rivalry. Now deadly rivals, the only way to resolve their differences is in a challenge to the death in the ring. When a power-enhancing drug has hallucinogenic side effects on kickboxer, Jack, he refuses to take it, and is then dropped by his manager. Desperate for money, he takes his teammate. Kevin's offer to deliver some cocaine, is a set-up to take the business away from the drug-lord, Henry.

programme.title: Sonny Chiba in Shogun's Samurai - Yagyuicizoku no Inbou: Episode 1
programme.desc: Following the massive success of the 1978 movie version, this TV series is newly produced by returning faces such as Director Kinji Fukasaku and actors Sonny Chiba and Kinnosuke Yorozuya. After the death of the second Tokugawa shogun Hidetada, his sons Iemitsu and Tadanaga shed family blood over the succession of the dynasty. Iemitsu's swordmaster Munenori Yagyu leads the Yagyu clan with his oldest son Jubei Yagyu and lends their swords to Iemitsu as they throw themselves into a bloody conflict.

programme.title: Mission Dynamo aka American Force 5: Mission Dynamo
programme.desc: The Vietnam War, and terrorists led by Torosky battle it out with South-Vietnamese guerrilla forces, assisted by the American Army. But for squad leader Merlin and private first class Bill the war has become so meaningless that they don't care anymore. After seeing more and more of their friends die, they decide to desert, but soon discover that there is no sanctuary in the jungle, when it's only a matter of time before Torosky's men will catch up with them.

programme.title: Enter the Panther
programme.desc: In this martial arts action movie, a young kung fu master seeks vengeance upon the villains who murdered a prominent miner.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 13
programme.desc: When Sengoku and the others arrive in a town based around prostitution, they are faced with a dilemma about the women who want to escape. The Tengu Bandits are also stirring up trouble.

programme.title: Sleeping Fist
programme.desc: Kam an undercover cop plans to report the crimes committed by Cho and his thugs. Beaten in a fight he is lucky Kid is nearby to rescue him and introduces him to Old Fox (Simon Yuen), who teaches them both Sleeping Fist Kung Fu.

programme.title: Enter the Game of Death
programme.desc: Kung Fu idol Bruce Le, takes on the mantel of the late Bruce Lee and delivers a powerhouse performance in what many consider to be his best film to date. Loosely based on Lee's original concept, and filmed in the actual location Lee had originally intended to use, Le does battle with a whole array of opponents, including the nunchaku master, snake fist fighter, wing chun expert, and a master of the mystic art of Silat.

programme.title: Master of Flying Daggers
programme.desc: Night Orchid is a notorious nickname attributed to a mysterious character that kills women, leaving an orchid as a signature after the murder. Only the Master of flying daggers, Chu Liu Hsiang can solve the mystery and restore peace to the martial world.

programme.title: Seven Steps of Kung Fu aka Kung Fu of Seven Steps
programme.desc: Little Tiger the town rascal and a pickpocket is also a kung fu disciple of the patriot Master Lee San Pai. One day Tiger steals a medallion from a stranger that is a member of a powerful gang, let by the White Haired Gerneral, who want to overthrow China with the help of Tibetan Lamas. Lee San Pai plots to beat the gang, but first Little Tiger must become and Kung Fu expert.

programme.title: Against Rascals with Kung Fu
programme.desc: Drunken master Sam the Seed takes on a young sheep herder as his newest disciple and teaches him some special kung tu techniques to help rid the town of a violent menace that has been terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Chinese Stuntman
programme.desc: Bruce Li plays a kung fu expert, who after a series of complicated events becomes a stuntman for a famous kung fu actor. He soon learns that the film's producers are trying to kill him, so they can cash in on his insurance policy.

programme.title: Ninja in the Killing Fields
programme.desc: The ruthless leader of a Ninja Organization plans to expand his drug dealing operation worldwide and a highly trained agent from America's Anti-Drug Agency is given the suicidal mission of seeking out and destroying him first.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Michelle Manu
programme.desc: Carrying the torch for the Hawaiian art of Kaihewalu Lua is Kumu Michelle Manu. Inducted into the Martial Arts History Museum's Hall of Fame in 2016, Manu has been the biggest advocate for promoting Lua across the globe. As the first female master of the art, this DVD takes a look at her life and her history and the impact Lau has had on her life.

programme.title: Ninja Demon's Massacre
programme.desc: Police are hot on the heels of ninjas involved in international espionage and that's got ninja gang leader Willie worried. When the police try to trick him, Willie reaches his boiling point.

programme.title: Shaolin vs Lama
programme.desc: Skilled fighter Sung Li Ting is looking for a Kung Fu master who can beat him in battle and teach him new techniques. Shaolin monk Shao Si Yer introduces Sung Li to the Shaolin teachings, but Sung Li is not allowed to enter the school until the return of a Lama Monk, who stole a secret scroll containing every known fighting style from the monastery 12 years earlier.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo Episode Seven: Shorinji Kempo
programme.desc: Mixing a martial art with a religios faith can be traced back to China over fifteen hundred years ago. Shorinji Kempo means 'Shaolin Temple Way of the Fist' and is both a fighting art and religion established by Doshin So, known as Kaiso to his many followers around the world. It is a unique combination of Karate style punches and kicks with the fluid throws of Aikido and joint-locks of Jujutsu.

programme.title: Chinese Hercules
programme.desc: Chan is a fighter haunted by his past. He takes a job as a dock worker in a small village. The dock owner steadily abuses his workers. The workers struggle to fight back, but only Chan is strong enough to beat the company bosses and their henchmen.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 3
programme.desc: from Shizu to assassinate Michinao Arima, lord of the Echizen Maruoka domain. Shizu's husband Murase was ordered to commit seppuku for criticizing Michinao as a vassal and died without being allowed to intervene. Shizu's husband Murase was ordered to commit seppuku (ritual suicide) for criticizing Michinao, even though he was a retainer. That night, Itto disappeared, leaving Daigoro behind.

programme.title: Born Invincible
programme.desc: All fear the White Haired Man! Director and producer Joseph Kuo, brings forth what is considered a Kung Fu Hall of Fame masterpiece! Shaw action director Robert Tai and Yuen Woo Ping and his clan join forces to bring a tour de force in action films. Carter Wong is the White Haired hermit, who has mastered Tai Chi, and uses it to deadly perfection.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 19
programme.desc: When Sengoku tries to rescue a young hostage, three "big shots" show up and interfere to save the day. But are they friend or foe?

programme.title: Nine Venoms aka The Nine Demons
programme.desc: After selling his soul to the devil, Joey is given the power to control 9 demons. With their help, Joey must save his childhood friend Gary from a bloody massacre.

programme.title: Ninja Operation 3 - Licensed to Terminate
programme.desc: Alpha, the Prince of Justice, is born to save the world from darkness and to protect mankind from the evil forces of the Black Ninja Empire, and the fearless and powerful Ninja Gordon has been chosen by his dying master to stop the nefarious Ninja Temple from killing this child. Gordon and Temple must confront each other in an ultimate showdown, using the ancient techniques of ninja combat at its best.

programme.title: Super Powerful Man
programme.desc: Fan Siu Wong returns as Riki! A military commander forces a scientist to train an army of super-combatants. The scientist's son, Ricky, formed in the same manner, is the most powerful of them all, giving him the nickname "the King of Invincible Power." The commander sends his four main killers: Wind, Rain, Thunder and Lightning, to try to kill Ricky, but they are easily defeated by him.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Tour
programme.desc: Museum founder and president Michael Matsuda provides a detailed tour of the world's first and only Martial Arts History Museum. You will learn about various forms of martial arts, their cultural impact on China, Japan, Korea, Thailand, the Philippines and Hawaii and how Asian history became part of American history. This is a very exciting tour in which you will learn so much about Asian culture and history and the positive influence on Western society.

programme.title: Golden Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Leader of the Golden Ninja, Max, is responsible for returning the Golden Ninja Warrior Statue to China, but his mortal enemy, the Red Ninja Empire, has sent their best man to stop him. A breath-taking series of events, actions and challenges ensues, as Max teams up with a female ninja to avenge her father's death and take on the might of Sakur

programme.title: Cold Justice Confessions
programme.desc: In 1981, a mother vanishes from the Hernando woods and the case goes cold and 33 years later, local detectives take the baton from Kelly and the Cold Justice team only to discover that getting a confession may be the only way to solve the case.

programme.title: Gustafsons
programme.desc: After their brother is convicted of murder, three siblings hatch a deadly plot to avenge him by targeting the star witness in his trial; the plan goes awry when the wrong person is on the receiving end of their vengeance.

programme.title: Stovalls
programme.desc: Twin sisters, raised with a deep disdain for law enforcement, are arrested for shooting a neighbor's dog, then escape custody and go on the run, leading to one of the deadliest shootouts in Colorado history.

programme.title: Williams
programme.desc: Raised in a strict home, Matthew and Tyler believe it's their duty to cleanse the world of those living in sin; when two men are found dead, the brother's connection to them points toward a hateful trail of crime.

programme.title: Bevers
programme.desc: Sheltered teenage brothers Robert and Michael Bever idolize serial killers and dream of being the most prolific murderers in history; with an arsenal of weapons, their quest for notoriety begins at home in their quiet Oklahoma suburb.

programme.title: Carrs
programme.desc: The Carr brothers arrive in Wichita, Kan., intending to commit robberies, but their plans quickly escalate to a murderous spree the likes of which Kansas had never seen; their reign of terror becomes known as the "Wichita Massacre."

programme.title: Rosas
programme.desc: After a man is found brutally murdered inside his own bar, a murder mystery unfolds over the span of years; detectives believe it's a business deal gone bad and must remain steadfastly dedicated to the case after hitting several dead ends.

programme.title: Lewis and Machuca
programme.desc: In the summer of 1991, a pair of half-siblings creates panic across southern California when they embark on a spree of random crimes of the worst kind, targeting people out doing everyday tasks.

programme.title: Brileys
programme.desc: Over a brutal 7-month stretch, a trio of brothers commit a series of increasingly violent crimes across the city of Richmond, leaving behind a growing body count; even after their apprehension, these brothers prove difficult to contain.

programme.title: Bondurants
programme.desc: A pair of larger-than-life identical twins commit a series of brutal attacks in a small Tennessee town; with each crime, the brothers grow more emboldened; as time goes on and with little evidence against them, there's no telling how far they'll go.

programme.title: Vues
programme.desc: When a correctional officer is murdered, it seems like an act of vengeance, but a love triangle is exposed; after learning his wife is having an affair, a husband plans to kill her lover and enlists the help of his brothers to carry out the task.

programme.title: Hawes
programme.desc: A missing persons case spirals down a winding path once detectives learn that a formerly beloved older brother appears to have embezzled money from the family's business; his siblings are hellbent on getting revenge.

programme.title: Fryers
programme.desc: In one of the most tragic and brutal crimes in the history of the Great Plains, five teens playing by a campfire are ambushed by a trio of shotgun-wielding brothers; a lone survivor bravely helps detectives hunt down her assailants.

programme.title: Suhs
programme.desc: An immigrant family's American dream turns into a nightmare when a devious sister manipulates her younger valedictorian brother into committing murder; a dark family secret comes to light.

programme.title: Rogers
programme.desc: In this bizarre Midwestern saga; a grudge between a shady district attorney and an eccentric local student turns deadly; investigators work for decades to bring a quartet of brothers to justice.

programme.title: Defranciscos
programme.desc: When a body is found badly burned outside of Chicago, police work tirelessly to track down the killer of this young, hardworking truck driver; the search leads them to an unlikely pair of teenage sisters who are able to evade capture for years.

programme.title: Youngs
programme.desc: When the patrons of a rural bar are murdered execution-style, two determined detectives work to track down a pair of killer brothers and solve the most heinous crime in the history of the small town.

programme.title: Polands
programme.desc: Two brothers pull off an elaborate scheme in the desert to rob an armored van of $300,000; when investigators attempt to track down the illusive robbers, the case becomes a homicide once the bodies of the two guards driving the van turn up.

programme.title: Romero & Self
programme.desc: In the fall of 1992, two brothers terrorize a California community when they embark on a two-month crime spree that includes three brutal murders and many more near-death attacks.

programme.title: Agofskys
programme.desc: Residents of quiet Noel, Mo., are shocked when the local bank is robbed in a brazen nighttime heist; the investigation takes a sinister turn when the bank's president is found dead and a pair of brothers suddenly come into a lot of cash.

programme.title: Bruces
programme.desc: Things get murky along the Tennessee River when a mussel distributor and his fiancée are killed by a trio of roughneck brothers who are determined to steal a big payout and silence anyone who gets in their way.

programme.title: Lunas
programme.desc: The ambitious Luna brothers take wildly divergent paths, one becoming a decorated army officer while another rises in a Mexican cartel; when the brothers' worlds collide, a murder ultimately brings them down.

programme.title: Kauffman and McMahan
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes rural Iowa as two women are found murdered in their homes; when a local bank is robbed the same day, investigators connect the crimes to an unfolding crime spree and race to find the killer siblings before they can strike again.

programme.title: Kimbles
programme.desc: A peaceful town is rocked by the murder of the young wife of a preacher's son; the investigation leads detectives to two brothers: one with a deadly ambition, and the other willing to do anything to earn his brother's love.

programme.title: Engels
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found in a burnt out station wagon, investigators unravel a deadly plot that leads back to a shattered marriage and two self-made millionaire brothers who feel entitled to do anything to anyone.

programme.title: Merricks
programme.desc: A double-homicide in a small Ohio town leads police to a family member with a grudge over $400 that leads two brothers to spiral out of control.

programme.title: Allridges
programme.desc: After three ruthless murders and a month-long spree of armed robberies, police in Fort Worth, Texas, race to stop a young man intent on inflicting pain, his honor student sibling and a second set of brothers.

programme.title: Galvan-Cernas
programme.desc: A home invasion by masked gunmen leads to the murder of a doctor trying to protect his family, but when investigators track down three brothers, they discover the kidnapping plot gone wrong was masterminded from within the doctor's own circle.

programme.title: Homicks & Woodmans
programme.desc: When a wealthy businessman and his wife are brutally gunned down, detectives discover a family torn apart by resentment and greed, and uncover a murder plot between the couple's sons and a second set of brothers hired to pull the trigger.

programme.title: Dennys
programme.desc: A rural community in Georgia is rocked by two double-homicides within 24 hours, including a beloved dairy farmer and his son, but a piece of evidence eventually leads detectives to two brothers.

programme.title: Matting & Smith
programme.desc: A man's murder outside his home in suburban Memphis leads investigators to multiple extramarital affairs, a wife's secret life, an insurance policy, and a brother willing to do anything for his sister.

programme.title: Freemans
programme.desc: Teen brothers rebel against their strict upbringing and become skinheads, and when their mother, father and younger brother are discovered murdered in their home, police begin a manhunt that leads them across three states.

programme.title: Pratt
programme.desc: A home invasion starts a massive manhunt through the remote, snowy wilderness of Idaho for two bank-robbing brothers who once helped catch a notorious Soviet spy.

programme.title: Vanishing Point
programme.desc: Crystal Rogers, mother of five, vanishes, leaving her car abandoned in Bardstown, Ky.; a year later her father is shot dead while searching for her; there are multiple cases in a small town shrouded in secrets, and haunted by unsolved killings.

programme.title: Tommy's Box
programme.desc: Stephanie and Dwayne look through Tommy Ballard's box of papers and evidence in Crystal's case.

programme.title: The Search Continues
programme.desc: The FBI grills the brother of Crystal's boyfriend, Nick Houck, a Bardstown police officer; Stephanie and Dwayne follow a search of a lake where cadaver dogs pick up a scent; exploring the scene of a deadly ambush on the Bluegrass Parkway.

programme.title: Cold and Calculating
programme.desc: An FBI profiler offers chilling insights on a potential killer; family members of Bardstown's other victims speak; a mysterious white car is possibly linked to Crystal's disappearance.

programme.title: A Murder Most Foul
programme.desc: With the first anniversary of Tommy Ballard's killing approaching, Stephanie and Dwayne dive deeper into the unsolved cases after a new witness steps forward; an unexpected new lead takes them in an unforeseen -- and intriguing -- direction.

programme.title: Final Days in Bardstown
programme.desc: Stephanie and Dwayne speak with an informant who shares new information about the crimes in Bardstown; they follow up on the informant's claims and discover potential new details unknown to investigators.

programme.title: Everyone Has a Theory
programme.desc: Journalist Maggie Freleng searches for answers in the 2004 disappearance of a nursing student following a car crash in New Hampshire.

programme.title: A Reason to Run
programme.desc: Maggie investigates reasons why Maura Murray secretly drove to New Hampshire and never came home, including a possible pregnancy or an emotional phone call with her sister.

programme.title: After the Crash
programme.desc: There are questions about happened to Maura after she crashed on a rural road in New Hampshire: did she run into the woods, hop into a car with someone she knew and escape to a new life in Canada, or worse, hitch a ride with a dangerous stranger.

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: New Hampshire's law enforcement community keeps their findings of Maura's case close to the chest; Maggie explores the theories related to a police conspiracy, hoping to break down a decade-long code of silence.

programme.title: Something Bad Happened
programme.desc: Killers and kidnappers are Maggie's focus as she works to find out if Maura Murray was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Summit
programme.desc: The DNA results are revealed; Maggie seeks the advice of a psychic; a wild lead is pursued at the top of a mountain; Maggie sits down with Maura's family and reveals evidence released by law enforcement for the first time in 13 years.

programme.title: If Something Happens to Me
programme.desc: A young mother in Utah vanishes and the only suspect, her husband, acts suspiciously; Stephanie Bauer examines never-before-seen home video recordings that shed light on the dramatic events surrounding the disappearance of Susan Cox Powell.

programme.title: A Family Affair
programme.desc: A defensive husband flees justice after the disappearance of his wife drags both of their families down deeper into destruction and tragedy.

programme.title: New Lead
programme.desc: Natalee Holloway disappears from Aruba in May 2005, and her father Dave never stops looking for her; he receives a new lead that could be the key to solving the 12-year-old mystery, but he has suspicions about the source.

programme.title: The Sting
programme.desc: Dave Holloway and a team of investigators pursue a lead that may shed light on his daughter's disappearance, with the goal of obtaining a taped confession and concrete evidence.

programme.title: The Sting: Day 2
programme.desc: The sting operation in New Orleans continues as the investigation team begins running out of time to obtain the necessary information from the co-conspirator.

programme.title: Aruba
programme.desc: TJ and his team head to Aruba to begin phase two of their investigation - attempting to obtain DNA evidence from Natalee's alleged burial site; Dave must convince his informant to go the extra mile.

programme.title: The Burial Site
programme.desc: TJ races to the location where the co-conspirator claims he dug up Natalee's remains in 2010; working with the Aruban authorities, they search for DNA that could lead to convicting those involved in Natalee's disappearance.

programme.title: The Bones
programme.desc: After two years following a lead, the investigators finally have evidence in hand that could answer the 12-year-old mystery of what happened to Natalee Holloway.

programme.title: Modern Family Murder
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a devoutly religious couple, police uncover dark family secrets, leading them to a shocking suspect.

programme.title: Dying to See You
programme.desc: When a popular college student is found slain in the middle of campus, police suspect his friends and lovers might be involved.

programme.title: A Twisted Connection
programme.desc: When a suburban mom is murdered in her own home, investigators chase down an elusive killer that no one saw coming.

programme.title: When Hate Kills
programme.desc: Police in small town Louisiana investigate the mysterious and brutal murder of a beloved neighbor with no known enemies.

programme.title: Killer in Plain Sight
programme.desc: After a college student is viciously murdered and her apartment set ablaze, police untangle a web of relationships to find a killer who's dangerously close to home.

programme.title: New Mexico Massacre
programme.desc: A couple and their special needs son are savagely murdered in rural New Mexico, leading detectives to uncover long-buried secrets in a tight-knit town.

programme.title: Deadly Intentions
programme.desc: A devoted mother about to begin a new life is murdered in her own home; detectives follow the evidence through a tangled web of relationships to unmask the killer.

programme.title: Deadly Betrayal
programme.desc: When a loving father and beloved basketball coach is murdered in Tennessee, police decode a confusing array of evidence to unveil a killer who is shockingly close to home.

programme.title: Twisted Betrayal
programme.desc: When a devoted mother with a bright future in show business is ruthlessly gunned down, a number of suspects emerges; just as detectives think they have the killer in their sights, the investigation takes a jaw-dropping turn.

programme.title: Unseen Assassin
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman and his closest friend are found shot execution-style; police have little to go on until a surprising development leads investigators to a killer no one ever suspected.

programme.title: A Genius Murder
programme.desc: When a brilliant scientist and devoted family man is found beaten to death, the evidence leads to arrests, but an astounding revelation turns the investigation on its head.

programme.title: Driven to Murder
programme.desc: When police find the body of a popular taxi driver stuffed inside the trunk of his own car, which is submerged in a river, they struggle to find suspects -- until the truth begins to emerge.

programme.title: The Love That Kills
programme.desc: A loving, single mother of two is the victim of a bizarre murder, leading detectives to investigate a number of suspects.

programme.title: Killed by Kindness
programme.desc: When a recently divorced mother is found strangled to death on her couch, several suspects emerge until the killer is revealed to be someone close to home.

programme.title: New Jersey Nightmare
programme.desc: A recently retired woman is found murdered, and detectives struggle with a lack of evidence and try to track down a long list of suspects.

programme.title: Fatal Ambition
programme.desc: A hard-working young woman is discovered stabbed at the side of a road, leading police on a tireless investigation for 10 years to unveil a killer who is hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: Deadly Disrespect
programme.desc: After a 35-year-old analyst for the NSA is fatally stabbed, police look at a number of suspects; detectives close in on the killer, but the investigation takes a shocking turn.

programme.title: Closet Murderer
programme.desc: When a 98-year-old widow is found dead in her entryway closet, a chilling discovery leads investigators to a killer in the community who harbors a dark secret.

programme.title: Murderer on Main St.
programme.desc: A beloved resident of a tight-knit Nebraska town is murdered, leading detectives to look at a wide range of suspects before the trail leads to a killer who lives among them.

programme.title: The Mayor's Wife
programme.desc: After a respected educator and mother of two is found dead in small-town Alabama, the investigation focuses on fraught family relationships, but the discovery of a dark secret unveils a killer no one saw coming.

programme.title: Hidden Betrayal
programme.desc: A civic-minded teen is shot to death in his own bed, but just as investigators are closing in on those responsible, a twist leaves everyone stunned.

programme.title: Gone Without a Trace
programme.desc: A divorced mother of three is stabbed to death while recovering from major surgery, but police are frustrated by a lack of evidence, until a startling admission reignites the case.

programme.title: Twisted Attraction
programme.desc: When a young woman who was just starting out in life is found assaulted and stabbed to death in her boyfriend's home, detectives work tirelessly to uncover a killer who had previously been above suspicion, leaving the town and police force stunned.

programme.title: Second Chance to Kill
programme.desc: Police searching for the killer of a beloved grandfather find the murderer close to home wielding a shocking weapon.

programme.title: The Finger of Suspicion
programme.desc: A young woman is killed in her bedroom, and the evidence appears to point to a clear suspect, but it takes 30 years and new evidence to reveal a killer hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: The Runaway Murderer
programme.desc: A glamorous 85-year-old millionaire is found stabbed in her basement, sending police on an international investigation that unearths devilish secrets, double lives and a killer no one saw coming.

programme.title: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: When a beloved elderly woman is viciously murdered, detectives discover a chilling connection to another unsolved murder; the trail points to someone from her past and investigators race to hunt the killer down before they can strike again.

programme.title: Burned and Betrayed
programme.desc: After the burned body of a young nursing student is discovered near a rural road, detectives investigate several suspects until the trail of evidence unearths a disturbing and predatory plot.

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: A week has passed since the fire and Alex's mysterious disappearance, but then he returns with his new fiancée and he unknowingly breaks Stevie's heart. Just when Tess is starting to get on top of things, she gets a call that sets her back: Nick's remains have been found.

programme.title: Truth Hurts
programme.desc: Alex and Fiona's engagement is publicly announced thanks to a meddling Harry. Meanwhile, a jealous Stevie, prompted by Dave, looks into Fiona's past and discovers something shocking. Meanwhile, Tess asks Jodi to move into the main house.

programme.title: Kiss of Death
programme.desc: Stevie is trying to deal with the fact that Alex may never be hers. She brings home a very young guy for the night, a move which ultimately endangers the land of Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi comforts Rob and they are brought closer together when he reveals a secret.

programme.title: Luck Be A Lady
programme.desc: After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts for organic produce and the women struggle to keep the bank from taking over. Trying to help, Stevie ends up gambling away Drover money.

programme.title: The Real McLeod
programme.desc: Jodi is stunned when Tess offers her half her share of Drovers Run. Tess feels that Jodi should have equity in the family heritage, as well as sharing their current debt. Leo, the pilot who dumped pesticide on Drovers Run, returns and tries to make Harry lift the black ban placed on him.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back. After numerous attempts to convince her to see a doctor, Dave abducts Kate and drives her to the Gungellan GP.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: Nick returns home to Drovers Run but is troubled by shadowy flashbacks of Argentina and his mugging. Meanwhile, Kate secretly goes to see a cancer specialist in the city, but Jodi figures out that something is going on and follows her.

programme.title: Where The Heart Is
programme.desc: Nick is anxious to start up the cattle breeding program he never had the chance to realise in Argentina. Tess and Stevie move Phoenix to a safer paddock, but another visit from the Brumbies leads to the discovery that she is already pregnant, no doubt to the brumby stallion.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: Jodi risks her own life in an attempt to save Rob from the hitman that is hunting him, and with her courage, common sense and bushcraft, they survive the daylight risk. Meanwhile, Dave's brother Patrick returns with a truckload of "liberated" goats.

programme.title: The Big Commitment
programme.desc: When Patrick is blinded in a farming accident, he must rely on Kate for help. Stevie and Fiona take on a dodgy horse dealer, gaining a new-found respect for each other. Meanwhile, Meg and Terry adopt a new dream together.

programme.title: Biting the Bullet
programme.desc: When Regan returns to Drovers Run, she reveals a tragic secret. Though Tess has left, Jodi, Kate, and Stevie allow her to stay. Meanwhile, Fiona learns she is infertile but hides this information from Alex.

programme.title: Second Best
programme.desc: When Harry's stud ram is stolen, the Drovers Run women unmask an unlikely sheep rustler. Stevie ends up as Alex's backup best man in case Nick is not back from Argentina in time for the wedding.

programme.title: The Trouble With Harry
programme.desc: Jodi is driving back to Drovers Run when her phone rings. For a split second, she takes her eyes off the road and collides with a ute that Harry was driving. Meanwhile, the Japanese trade delegation visits to make an export deal with 'Gungellan Fresh'.

programme.title: The Legend of Harry Ryan
programme.desc: As he prepares for his father's funeral, Alex becomes obsessed with finding out why Harry had secreted away so many things. Stevie struggles to tell Alex that she argued with Harry on the day he died, and fears that it might have prompted the heart attack that killed him.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: Kevin returns unexpectedly and Jodi tells him the news about her real father. He isn't too surprised, though, and Jodi is later devastated to find he was just trying to access her inheritance money.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: The day before the big wedding has arrived and Stevie makes a shocking discovery that Fiona has been lying to Alex about being pregnant. Meanwhile, Kate decides to try on Fiona's dress and manages to stain it.

programme.title: The Life of Riley
programme.desc: After a group of brumbies are found shot dead, the girls of Drovers Run suspect a handsome stranger named Riley. Meanwhile, Sandra moves back into Killarney in hopes of carrying out Harry's legacy while Alex is absent

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: Stevie and Riley have gone into partnership to train the brumbies they saved from the national park, but they clash over techniques when they must have a horse ready for sale in one day. Meanwhile, Sandra and Fiona realise they're at a stalemate when they both secure damaging information about the other.

programme.title: The Great Temptation
programme.desc: Regan's horse-riding lessons have paid off. She is feeling confident in her ability and excited by the prospect of riding with the Drovers Cross Country team. After a mistake, Regan discovers that Drovers Run lost a contract to Sandra because she caused a paratyphoid outbreak in some cattle.

programme.title: Suspicious Minds
programme.desc: When evidence begins to mount against Stevie, Kate starts to believe that she could be the cause of Harry Ryan's death and must decide if she should go to the police with her suspicions. Meanwhile, Riley learns a local trainer abuses his horses and plans to do something about it.

programme.title: Days of Reckoning
programme.desc: Kate, who went to the police with her suspicions about Stevie's involvement in Harry's death, struggles to deal with the consequences of her actions. Alex returns from Argentina to find much has changed since he left, and he's got a lot to handle straight away.

programme.title: Scratch the Surface
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are determined to discover who killed Harry Ryan. When Leo returns to the district and locks horns with Stevie, she becomes convinced that he is the killer. Meanwhile, Alex discovers that Fiona has lied about her pregnancy.

programme.title: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Taking a short cut along the stock route, Moira is horrified when her petrol tanker has a dangerous fuel spill on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi and Kate struggle to make a decision about the future of the ranch given the possibility that Stevie may go to jail.

programme.title: The Eleventh Hour
programme.desc: Steve is busy trying to tie up loose ends before her trial begins, and Fiona joins the CFS in an attempt to show Alex how she can integrate herself into the town. When Alex and Riley are away from Killarney, doors all over the property are left open.

programme.title: Old Wrongs
programme.desc: Stevie's daughter, Rose, is coming to stay for a month, and it's the first time they've seen each other in two years. Stevie hopes to rebuild their relationship, but Rose is clear that she is only here for work experience.

programme.title: Handle With Care
programme.desc: Rose secretly begins seeing Leo, unaware of his history with Stevie. Meanwhile, Riley, Alex, Jodi and Kate take cattle along the stock route overnight.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
programme.desc: After Rose and Stevie enthusiastically prepare dinner for Rose's "mystery man," the girls are horrified when they see whom the date turns out to be. Meanwhile, Kate wants to apply for the Young Farmer of the Year award but is crushed when she learns that Jodi has entered as well since Kate has never beaten Jodi at anything.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Jodi has introduced Boer goats onto Drovers and wants to associate them with Gungellan Fresh. Phil Rakich is instantly opposed to the idea and bad mouths the animals, which causes tension with Riley.

programme.title: Winners & Losers
programme.desc: When Alex returns from the city with Fiona, Stevie fears he's changed his mind about leaving his wife. Meanwhile, Jodi and Patrick fight over who knows Kate the best.

programme.title: Damage Control
programme.desc: During a storm, Jodi wakes from a nightmare about fleeing from the hitman with Rob. Stevie wakes alone and full of remorse, while Alex wakes up in his ute, heartbroken after seeing Stevie with another man.

programme.title: Risk
programme.desc: After being offered a two-year research job in Africa, Dave tries to pretend he isn't interested. Meanwhile, Kate wins the Young Farmers Award but risks losing the man she loves when Patrick discovers he doesn't know Kate as well as he thought.

programme.title: Twenty Questions
programme.desc: After learning of Dave's plan to move to Africa, Kate realises she still has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Fiona turns up at Killarney claiming half of the furniture and sets the tone of the conflict by sawing the dining room table in half.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: It's shearing time at Drovers Run and Jodi is happy until her conflicted feelings for Rob recently returned (now going by his real name of Matt) and Riley rise to the surface.

programme.title: All The Wrong Places
programme.desc: Kate's romantic exit has stirred up some confusing emotions for Jodi who becomes obsessed with building a new dam on Drovers, with near tragic results.

programme.title: Digging Up The Past
programme.desc: Jodi is spooked by a mysterious vision and develops an angry rash on her wrists and ankles. Meanwhile, Tayler worries when Regan doesn't return on time but has her hands full caring for an injured possum with Patrick.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Alex and Marcus come to blows over the future of Killarney, and Marcus reveals a secret that will change their lives forever. Meanwhile, Jodi is determined to help Riley make peace with his estranged father, Bill, when he visits Drovers Run.

programme.title: Reaching Out
programme.desc: Jodi questions her sanity when she is haunted by visions of her ancestor Emma McLeod and a murdered convict. Alex, angry that Marcus lied to him for so long, is doing his best to not deal with the fact that he and Marcus are brothers.

programme.title: Returned Favour
programme.desc: Jodi has her hands full with a major decision when both Riley and Matt declare their love for her. Meanwhile, Stevie may risk losing Alex again when she helps Marcus with a cattle deal.

programme.title: Of Hearts and Hunters
programme.desc: For Jodi and Matt, love is blossoming, and the world is looking remarkably sunny. Jodi suggests Matt move in permanently, and we find Matt making plans to ask Jodi to marry him, but Jodi faces a gut-wrenching decision when Matt is forced back into witness protection.

programme.title: Climb Every Mountain
programme.desc: Kate has a hard time coming to grips with her best friend's death and she decides to investigate the case of Jodi and Matt's murders herself. Meanwhile, Stevie has taken over a meeting that Jodi organised with Natural Resource Management and is determined to make her proud.

programme.title: Sisters are Doing It For Themselves
programme.desc: When Regan's sister Grace inherits part of Drovers Run from Jodi, Regan tries to reconcile with her. Stevie convinces Alex that they should keep their relationship a secret, but they quickly prove to be utterly hopeless at staying low-key.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Alex's plan to propose to Stevie goes horribly wrong when a series of accidents and disasters threaten to ruin their relationship. Meanwhile, Kate and Riley are caught in a game of theft and deception over stray cattle, as Moira finds herself on a date with Phil Rakich.

programme.title: Bloodlines
programme.desc: When sheep rustlers steal Drovers' breeding stock, Grace and Stevie take the law into their own hands. Meanwhile, Regan tries her best to convince her sister to make her stay on the ranch permanent.

programme.title: Warts and All
programme.desc: Stevie is not looking forward to being nothing more than "Mrs. Alex Ryan," and there are responsibilities that her new position brings. Bryce arrives for the engagement party, bearing an unwanted pre-nup.

programme.title: Conflicts of Interest
programme.desc: The girls fight to stop Drovers Run becoming the site of a toxic waste dump. Grace forces Regan to choose between her family and her rekindled relationship with her lover who is in charge of the site testing.

programme.title: Flesh and Stone
programme.desc: Grace kidnaps a government official to prevent the toxic dump from going ahead. Regan is also fighting to save Drovers Run, though her relationships with Grace and Lyle may reach a crisis point in the process.

programme.title: All's Fair In Love and War
programme.desc: Rose arrives at Drovers Run accompanied by Stevie's mother, Helen. Rose hoped to act as a peacemaker between the two, but instead, years of bitterness pour out.

programme.title: Ever After
programme.desc: On Alex and Stevie's long-awaited wedding day, things will run smoothly if the groom is able to get out of jail in time to make it to the altar. Meanwhile, Alex's sister Ashleigh attempts to ruin the wedding and take over Killarney.

programme.title: Grace Under Fire
programme.desc: While clashing with a rich new neighbour, Heath Barrett, Grace becomes convinced she's cursed Drovers Run when a series of bizarre plagues strike the farm. Meanwhile, while Alex is away on his honeymoon with Stevie, Ashleigh runs amok when she undermines Marcus' authority on Killarney.

programme.title: Gift Horse
programme.desc: ile desperately trying to resist Heath's charms, Grace questions her future on Drovers Run when she learns that her best friend has died.

programme.title: Hot Water
programme.desc: Grace may be making a deal with the devil when she accepts a secret loan from Ashleigh after the bank refuses credit to Drovers Run. Meanwhile, after Grace and Kate are taken hostage by a bankrupt farmer, Moira has a premonition that someone will get shot by the gunman.

programme.title: Leaving the Nest
programme.desc: Stevie returns from her honeymoon and plans to spend the summer with Rose before she starts university, but Rose has plans of her own which involve taking a year off to travel overseas. Meanwhile, Grace is forced to take desperate measures to repay Ashleigh, and Riley trains a new horse.

programme.title: Spark From Heaven
programme.desc: Rose returns from the hospital in a wheelchair and is involved in a freak car crash that may not have been an accident. Moira convinces the girls to do a naked rain dance, with unexpected results, and sceptic Phil gains a new respect for Moira's psychic gifts.

programme.title: The Courage Within
programme.desc: While the girls are investigating a mysterious explosion at the fuel dump, wheelchair-bound Rose is trapped at the homestead during a brazen robbery attempt. Meanwhile, Marcus and Heath clash over Grace's controversial drought-proofing plan, and Ashleigh blackmails Grace into lying to the police.

programme.title: Divided We Stand
programme.desc: Stevie's loyalty to Drovers Run is tested when she moves into Killarney. Meanwhile, Grace is trying to move ahead with her drought-proofing plan. Kate falls for Mitch, an ex-army mate of Riley's, who arrives with a dark secret and Riley makes a dangerous enemy when he rejects Ashleigh's advances.

programme.title: On The Prowl
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run team up with the men from Killarney to hunt the dangerous beast that is killing Drovers stock. Meanwhile, Riley discovers Mitch is trading stolen army weapons, and while Riley's unwilling to turn him into the police, Ashleigh has no such qualms.

programme.title: Fanning the Flames
programme.desc: Blinded by love, Kate decides to go on the run with her outlaw boyfriend Mitch. Meanwhile, Drovers Run and other local farms are the victims of a professional arsonist.

programme.title: My Enemy My Friend
programme.desc: Grace faces an uphill battle to save Ashleigh's life when they are left stranded in the bush after being involved in a serious car accident on an isolated road. Meanwhile, an expensive stud bull is poisoned on Drovers Run, and the girls are convinced someone is trying to bankrupt them.

programme.title: Knight In Shining Armour
programme.desc: During preparations for a Medieval Fair organised for drought relief, Grace is shocked when Heath proposes marriage. With Ashleigh having called in her loan and Drovers under threat, the girls decide to hold an auction to raise the necessary cash, selling off everything they can spare.

programme.title: The Short Cut
programme.desc: Grace takes drastic action to capture a cattle thief, and the girls uncover Ashleigh's secret plan to bankrupt Drovers Run. The girls team up to try and stop her before it's too late to save the ranch.

programme.title: Seeing Is Believing
programme.desc: It's Halloween and odd things occur on Drovers Run as the horror stories the girls tell over dinner start to come true. Kate is convinced she has killed Ashleigh in a hit-and-run accident, but can't find the body anywhere.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: The arrival of a mysterious stranger forces Grace to reconsider her future with Heath. He wants to move them to Queensland to take over a horse stud and set up camp drafting school.

programme.title: Mixed Messages
programme.desc: Marcus suspects Heath is cheating on Grace, but jealousy might be clouding his judgement. Grace starts to question Heath's love for her until Heath surprises her with an amazing gift.

programme.title: Silent Night
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve, and Alex makes a surprise return from Argentina to visit Stevie. Meanwhile, Grace finds proof of Heath's infidelity, and Kate and Riley finally admit their attraction to each other when they kiss under the mistletoe.

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: The car accident has thrown everyone off balance. Kate is obsessed with proving Riley survived, Grace tries to find the mystery person who rescued her, and Patrick mistakenly feels he's invincible.

programme.title: The Pitfalls of Love
programme.desc: Grace and Marcus are trapped at the bottom of an abandoned mine shaft, and help needs to arrive before Grace develops severe hypothermia. Kate helps Father Dan by caring for a cantankerous elderly woman who has some useful advice for grieving Kate

programme.title: Wild Ride
programme.desc: Stevie's wild-at-heart former rodeo mate, Sharon, visits Drovers Run and turns everyone's lives upside down. Meanwhile, Marcus sacrifices his chances in a major horse endurance race to save Ingrid from an abusive rider.

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Kate is finishing her pipe project when she comes across a young runaway, Jamie, broken down on the stock route. She tries to talk to him, but he runs, stealing her car. Eventually, Kate catches Jamie.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: There seems to be an intruder haunting Drovers and Moira is spooked by strange noises in the night. Eventually, they discover the culprit: a grubby, nine-year-old girl called Lily. Moira is suspicious, and when her dad, Frank, picks her up, he is clearly hiding something.

programme.title: Close Enough to Touch
programme.desc: Alex returns from Argentina and his reunion with Stevie begins blissfully. Moira has helped her set up a romantic picnic spot for their first supper together since the honeymoon.

programme.title: Bringing Up Wombat
programme.desc: Stevie decides to leave Drovers Run and move to Killarney to secure her son's future, but in the wake of the tragedy, she makes a series of rash management decisions that do just the opposite.

programme.title: Three Sisters
programme.desc: Jaz returns to Drovers Run and clashes with Grace, leaving Regan stuck playing the role of peacemaker. Stevie, however, is glad to see Jaz and feels their old tensions are behind them. Jaz volunteers to help out around the farm but discovers she's picked up the wrong bag at the bus stop.

programme.title: Dammed
programme.desc: The girls of Drovers Run band together with the local community to stop a massive dam being built upstream. When Olympic-hopeful Jaz is made the face of the campaign, she finds herself blackmailed by pro-dam farmer Terri Barker, who threatens to reveal an explosive secret from her past.

programme.title: Mother Love
programme.desc: Tayler and Patrick's happy domesticity is disrupted when Tayler's mother, Jane, returns. Jane wants to set the record straight with her daughter about why she left, but Tayler is wary. Meanwhile, baby Xander has not smiled yet, and it's worrying Stevie immensely.

programme.title: Bright Lights, Big Trouble
programme.desc: Grace, Jaz, Marcus, and Frank head off to the city to confront the Minister responsible for a dam proposal that will take away their water. Meanwhile, Phil gives Moira a personal and surprising gift.

programme.title: Love and Let Die
programme.desc: Jaz is taken aback when Lily reveals her dad, Frank, is talking about proposing to her. Jaz needs to decide how to deal with the situation. Frank's hopes for a stable family life take a pounding when he learns that his ex-wife has a new job in Queensland and intends to take Lily with her.

programme.title: A Dog's Life
programme.desc: Marcus has been looking for a new overseer for weeks, but given his constant clashing with Ben, neither of them can accept that Ben is right for the job. The district Yard Dog trials are fast approaching when Ben is befriended by a border collie.

programme.title: My Prince Will Come
programme.desc: After finding her horse from Europe grazing in the paddock, Jaz is surprised to discover she has been personally delivered by Mischa. The others are stunned to discover Mischa is a wealthy prince and Jaz's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Snogging Frogs
programme.desc: Concerned that Jaz is getting caught up in Mischa's scheme to clear her name, Grace threatens to report him to the officials if he puts Jaz at risk by going through with his plan. Moira debates telling Phil she is pregnant, and his reaction is far from what she expected.

programme.title: The Merry Widow
programme.desc: Rumours run amok after the ball, as the town believes Steve is dating Marcus. Repercussions occur when one man, Ted Franklin, causes problems for Drovers Run and Tayler takes it upon herself to dig up gossip on him to bargain with.

programme.title: Show Pony
programme.desc: Following a costly accident, Ben helps Jaz try to determine what is spooking her horse, Annie, as she hopes to use her for work on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Grace discovers that some of the new Drovers cattle have been stolen, and Tayler poses as Ingrid's assistant after a mistake.

programme.title: Trackdown
programme.desc: Nash attempts to apprehend a former best friend who has become an international mercenary sent to San Francisco for a hit.

programme.title: The Brothers McMillan
programme.desc: Dead bodies begin surfacing as two brothers vie for control of the Irish mafia in San Francisco; Joe suspects someone is stealing from his bar.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Nash and his team take the subway home from a bachelor party and are held hostage after walking into the midst of a robbery.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Nash calls on his former mentor, Dale Cutter, for help in a murder case that has all the signs of the infamous Zodiac killings.

programme.title: Leo's Big Score

programme.title: Hit Parade
programme.desc: A money launderer-turned-informant is killed, and Nash and Joe discover they are next in line unless they can find the hit man first.

programme.title: Promised Land

programme.title: 25 Hours of Christmas

programme.title: Inside Out

programme.title: The Counterfeiters

programme.title: The Web

programme.title: Knockout

programme.title: Gun Play

programme.title: Rampage

programme.title: Out of Chicago

programme.title: Moving Target

programme.title: Wild Card

programme.title: Deliverance

programme.title: Lost and Found

programme.title: Shake, Rattle and Roll

programme.title: One Flew Over the 'Cuda's Nest

programme.title: Blackout

programme.title: Ripcord

programme.title: Sniper
programme.desc: Nash and Joe track a sniper in San Francisco; a social club celebrates Halloween daily; guest Cassandra Peterson, "Elvira."

programme.title: Revelations

programme.title: Most Wanted

programme.title: Bombshell

programme.title: Found Money

programme.title: Dirty Tricks

programme.title: Crossfire

programme.title: Live Shot

programme.title: Downtime

programme.title: Skin Deep
programme.desc: Nash clashes with a visiting New York detective over the handling of a stalker case; Evan loses his badge during a one-night stand.

programme.title: Patriots

programme.title: Cuda Grace
programme.desc: Drug-related murders lead to a millionaire; Evan and Bettina go undercover at a transgender beauty pageant; guest RuPaul.

programme.title: Lady Killer
programme.desc: Nash tries to figure out who is framing Bettina for murder; someone is using Joe's stolen credit cards to live the playboy lifestyle.

programme.title: Danger Zone

programme.title: Special Delivery

programme.title: Touchdown

programme.title: Sacraments

programme.title: High Fall

programme.title: Impostors

programme.title: Hot Prowler

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: Nash and Joe scramble to find enough evidence to prove the innocence of a man on death row; a parent sues Joe, claiming his daughter is mistreating his son in preschool.

programme.title: Apocalypse Nash
programme.desc: Nash and Joe share a jail cell while awaiting trial over the murder of three fellow police officers during a drug bust.

programme.title: The Tourist

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin pose as a married couple while investigating wife-swapping parties; Joe helps steal a corpse.

programme.title: Warplay
programme.desc: Wealthy businessmen play a bizarre war game that leads to deadly consequences; Evan's lover is the assistant district attorney's fiancée.

programme.title: Firestorm
programme.desc: Nash's mysterious friend helps in the search for a murderous arsonist; Joe tries to throw a surprise party for Nash.

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Nash and Joe attempt to prevent a zealous INS agent from deporting a baseball star who is in the country illegally.

programme.title: Mystery Dance
programme.desc: Caitlin reveals details about her past to Nash; Joe battles a strict exercise and diet program; Cassidy and Nick team up for a tango competition.

programme.title: Shoot the Moon
programme.desc: Caitlin accidentally shoots Nash in the posterior; his pompous nemesis (Daniel Roebuck) replaces him.

programme.title: Gimme Shelter
programme.desc: While Nash pursues a gang of teenage carjackers, Joe goes undercover at a department store to catch a thief.

programme.title: Superstition
programme.desc: Nash must protect a young singer from obsessed fans intent on kidnapping her; Joe's attempt to buy his wife a car at a police auction backfires.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Nash's daughter faces death after a car crash; a sniper is loose in the city; Joe battles rats; guest Dee Wallace Stone.

programme.title: Pump Action
programme.desc: An undercover police officer joins forces with Nash to put a choke hold on marauding bodybuilders who are pumped up on illegal steroids.

programme.title: Hide and Seek
programme.desc: Nash and Joe try to find the governor of California after he slips out of sight, fearing the exposure of a possible sex scandal involving his mistress.

programme.title: Boomtown
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a serial bomber; Cassidy must perform topless in her new play while her father is in the audience; Nick befriends a noisy band.

programme.title: Angel of Mercy
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a serial killer; Caitlin and Joe coach girls' soccer teams; Harvey reconciles with his estranged wife.

programme.title: Power Play
programme.desc: Nash and Joe must cure an amnesiac to rescue a man from the Russian mob; Joe undergoes fertility tests.

programme.title: Vendetta

programme.title: Crash and Burn

programme.title: Frisco Blues
programme.desc: Internal affairs demotes Nash and Joe to walking a beat; Cortez becomes a traffic officer; Leek goes to homicide; Caitlin works vice detail.

programme.title: Goodbye Kiss
programme.desc: The unit faces permanent closure; Caitlin plans to leave; Nash and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) compete for Caitlin.

programme.title: Truth and Consequences
programme.desc: The team searches for an actress's assassin; Caitlin moves in with Nash; Inger wants Joe to go to Sweden.

programme.title: Trade Off
