programme.title: Smash and Grab
programme.desc: Thieves pose as firefighters responding to jewelry store fires only to steal the goods; the unit must uncover a litigious in-line skater's insurance scam.

programme.title: Girl Trouble
programme.desc: Nash must save Cassidy from drug dealers who mistake her for another woman; Joe meets the person he has been flirting with online.

programme.title: High Society
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin ask Jake Cage (Steve Austin) to help identify a dangerous fugitive at a posh wedding.

programme.title: Curveball
programme.desc: Nash and the team must track down a corrupt official who plans to leave the country with $5 million in pension funds; Caitlin accidentally throws one of Nash's prized possessions through a window.

programme.title: Split Decision
programme.desc: An ex-con claims to suffer from multiple personalities when he is caught robbing banks; Nick moves to a high-class retirement home; Harvey confronts Evan about his substance abuse.

programme.title: Get Bananas
programme.desc: Nash and Joe must protect a famous chimpanzee from animal rights activists wishing to release him into the jungle; Jake Cage searches for a wanted murderer; Evan pursues a drug dealer without Nash's approval.

programme.title: Crosstalk
programme.desc: Nash tracks a paranoid, delusional man who randomly kills cell-phone users; Nash and Joe investigate the decapitation of a dummy; Joe's dreams about Caitlin interfere with his waking hours.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: Nash and the team track down a vigilante intent on bringing murderers to justice; Caitlin and Joe form a partnership to deliver doughnuts via the Internet.

programme.title: Rip Off
programme.desc: The team must track down two gangs of robbers, one of which has an informant in its ranks who is tipping off the rival one.

programme.title: Glimmer Men
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Fort Henry
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Congress Theatre
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Hauntings
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: New Hampshire Gothic
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Pensacola Lighthouse
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Mark Twain House
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Unexplained Phenomena
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Hindenburg Crash Site
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Alcatraz Island
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Fort Ticonderoga
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Shamrock Spirits
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Phantom of Jersey
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Touched By Evil
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Haunted Reform School
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghosts in the Attic
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Inn of the Dead
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Spirits of the Night
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Norwhich State
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Haunted Hotel
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Uninvited Guests
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Signals from the Past
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Lemp Mansion
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Grammer School Ghosts
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Time to Get Touched
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

programme.title: The Chopping Block
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Oldest House in Georgia
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Home is Where the Haunt Is
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!

programme.title: Empire State Haunts
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team. Before the team heads out, we learn that Kris and Britt will be joining the GHI team and heading to Eastern Europe. The fort was built in 1755. During the French and Indian War, local Native American tribes defeated the British, killing over 1,000 people.

programme.title: Sloss Furnaces
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost of Christmas Past
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Haunted Town
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Pennsylvania Asylum
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Century of Hauntings
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: French Quarter Phantoms
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Hotel Haunts Unleashed
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. Some of the paranormal activity reported are apparitions, voices, objects being moved, growling sounds, and a story of a bride to be either being killed or committing suicide. The TAPS team also welcomes Maddie, the ghost-hunting dog.

programme.title: Frozen in Fear
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Residual Haunts
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. Some of the reported activity has been sounds of stones skipping, doors opening, apparitions, and a strong feeling of evil being felt. Britt is back with the TAPS team and the guys get set up. Jason and Grant start in Long Alley, and the guys see something strange appear on the thermal camera.

programme.title: Knights of the Living Dead
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Some of the activity that has been reported is loud knocking, banging, footsteps, music, doors opening/closing, and the apparition of the former owner. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: A Soldier's Story
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some of the reported paranormal activity is a woman in white, as well as a gentleman in a period suit, and shadows. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Pearl Harbor Phantoms
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Urgent!
programme.desc: Last time on Ghost Hunters, the team was in Hawaii investigating the Pacific Aviation Museum with special guest Josh Gates, when Steve called Jason with an urgent personal case back in Rhode Island that involves a terrified 4 year old. Jason and Grant hop the first flight back, and meet up with Steve at TAPS headquarters to get the low down on this next case. While there they conference in to do the reveal back in Hawaii with Tango and Amy.

programme.title: Hill View Manor
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. Before closing in 2004, this old nursing facility had many reports of death by suicide. Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.title: Dark Shadows
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal group to investigate Seaview Terrace in Newport, RI. Built in 1923 by the Bradley family, Seaview Terrace is recognizable from TV's "Dark Shadows" which filmed there in the 1960's. Some of the reported activity includes an apparition of Mrs. Bradley, voices, feelings of being watched, seeing faces, and the temperature fluctuating. Jason and Grant start out in the Great Hall and try to get Mrs.

programme.title: Ghostly Evidence
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Townsend, Massachusetts to investigate the Townsend Historical Society's two houses; the Reed Homestead and the Spaulding Cooperage. The main goal is to help staff not be afraid of paranormal activity that seems to be taking place at both properties. Built in 1809, the Reed Homestead was home to four generations of the Oliver Reed family. One of Oliver Reed's four daughters, Hannah, hanged herself after the death of her young daughter.

programme.title: Ghost of CarnegieD
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Harvesting Murder
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hawaii's Plantation Village, which was once a sugar plantation. It it is now an outdoor museum with reports of spirits still wandering the property and the many authentically replicated homes. It is believed that some of the entities seen are those who committed suicide or were murdered.

programme.title: Wells of Horror
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS and Jason's daughter, Haily, head to Napanoch, New York to investigate the Shanley Hotel. Since its opening in 1845, The Shanley Hotel has been plagued by an abundance of inexplicable deaths and tragic events targeting children. One of these tragic stories involved a little girl named Rosie, who died as she fell down a well while playing with friends. Some of the reports are of apparitions and toys moving in various rooms of the hotel.

programme.title: Roasts and Ghosts
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to ever investigate the historic Friars Club in New York City. Built in 1904 and famous for its roasts, TAPS has been brought in to find out if comedian, Al Kelly, is behind all the activity. There have been reports that an old man can be heard grunting, cold air surrounding someone, lockers moving, shadows, and apparitions of a man sitting at a table.

programme.title: Stage Fright
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Niagara Falls, NY to investigate paranormal activity that has been reported at Rapids Theater. Claims revolve around an actress who is said to have hanged herself backstage. People have heard the sound of high heels, whistling, doors opening and closing on their own and apparitions have being seen around the stage and bar areas.

programme.title: Murdered Matron
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Snug Harbor, in Staten Island, New York. The team is very excited to be joined by Meredith Vieira, who will help them investigate this large property that includes historic landmark buildings. The investigation focuses on a lady in white who has been seen floating throughout Snugs Harbor. She is believed to be a laundry worker, known as a Matron, who was murdered by her thirteen year old son, who she kept chained inthe basement.

programme.title: The Bloodiest 47 Acres
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri to investigate Missouri State penitentiary. Having opened in 1836,it stood as oneof the oldest and most violent prisons in America, and was referred to as "the bloodiest 47 acres". While still operational, both guards and inmates reported strange experiences at the penitentiary. It continued even after its doorsclosed. Some of the activity reportedincludes apparitions of men and women, doors slamming, and footsteps.

programme.title: Voices of Pain
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads back to the fan favorite, Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, where more activity has been reported and a nurse's wing has been opened up for TAPS to explore. The activity reported includes solid dark shadows and voices. Stave and Tango start out their night in the Death Tunnel where they hear sounds, and loud slams, but can't figure out what caused it.

programme.title: Distillery of Spirits
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to one of the oldest distilleries in America, Buffalo Trace, in Frankfort, Kentucky. Operating since the 18th century, its former president, Colonel Blanton, is believed to still be roaming the buildings. He worked and lived at the distillery for over 55 years, before passing away at his home, which was on the property.

programme.title: Membership Denied
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity. Next they head to Morse Mill Hotel, in Morse Mill, Missouri - a hotel with a violent past. They are called in to help a client who is dealing with threatening spirits that emerged as renovations began.

programme.title: Roller Ghoster
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Buyer Beware
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Naples, New York, to investigate the Naples Hotel. This hotel was built in 1895. There was a suicide at the hotel in the 1920's, which is when the activity is said to begin. The owners believe the ghost of the victim is still there and have nicknamed him "Topper." Some of the reported activity includes apparitions, voices, and objects being thrown.

programme.title: Flooded Souls
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hales Bar Dam and Marina in Tennessee, to investigate a dam that was built on Native American land. It is believed that a Cherokee chief cursed this property after he was forced off it. Due to numerous problems, Hales Bar Dam took eight years to complete and was finally finished in 1907. During the building of this dam there were many tragedies such as accidental deaths, including workers being buried alive in cement walls.

programme.title: Dead & Breakfast
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates a 19th century Bed and Breakfast in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, built by the Cloyd family. Over the years, many members of the Cloyd family passed away at this property. The current owners, the Coles, believe the Cloyds never left and are haunting the hotel. People have seen several full body apparitions, matching the descriptions of various Cloyd members. Whistling has been heard, a lady in pink has been seen as well as a man in black.

programme.title: Moonshine & Madness
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Wythe County, Virginia to answer a call for help at one of the town's most feared houses - The Graham Mansion. This foreboding, twenty-five room home has witnessed a twisted history of evil through the centuries starting with a slave owner in the 1700's who was murdered by his two slaves. In the 1800's, Squire David Graham purchased the home. His wife suffered from mental illness and was locked-up in the basement.

programme.title: City Hell
programme.desc: TAPS, minus Grant, answers a call for help from Providence City Hall where paranormal activity is threatening the staff. And now there is also concern for the hundreds of citizens who pass through this building every day. Built in 1878, this prominent building has the city's history tucked away between its walls, including a ghostly former mayor who is refusing to leave office...even when on the other side.

programme.title: Ghost of a Marine
programme.desc: TAPS heads out to investigate the U.S. Naval Institute in Annapolis, Maryland, where a marine's death remains a mystery and his ghost still roams the property.

programme.title: A Family of Spirits
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Haunted by Heroes
programme.desc: Grant's last show draws even closer, but in the meantime the cases keep coming, and this one is very exciting for the whole team; the USS Yorktown in Mt. Pleasant, South Carolina. This is an 872-foot warship, which served in WWII as well as Vietnam and also recovered the Apollo 8 astronauts and space capsule. The USS Yorktown has carried thousands of men and lost more than 140 of them while in battle. Most were pilots who never returned from their missions.

programme.title: The Princess and the EVP
programme.desc: As Grant's final show is now just a case away, the team revisits an old favorite of his, Mt. Washington in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. Not only was this the resort Grant honeymooned at 15 years ago but it later became a location that provided incredible evidence for the team. Now there are new claims and more areas and rooms open to the TAPS team.

programme.title: Please Sign the Ghost Book
programme.desc: For Grant's last episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team decides to stay close to home and investigate Jason and Grant's very own Spalding Inn. GHI investigated their Inn before, but this will be TAPS' first opportunity. The Spalding Inn was originally a summer home named Cherry Hill House that began taking in guests in 1865. It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Frighternity
programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: A Serial Killer's Revenge
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Swedish Invasion
programme.desc: James and David work with a long-time client Zach Vella to list an architectural gem, but Fredrik's arrival in Los Angeles is putting the pressure on them to get it sold.

programme.title: Medieval Time Machine
programme.desc: Altman lists a castle in Beverly Ridge; Flagg finds himself opposite Fredrik, trying to negotiate a deal while getting a fair price for his client; James and David are under pressure to get their latest Zach Vella listing sold.

programme.title: One for the 'Gram
programme.desc: Altman throws an epic launch event for a modern with a $48 million price tag and a social media twist; Tracy gets creative to find a buyer for her new WeHo modern; Los Angeles wildfires have a devastating impact on the market.

programme.title: Hollywood Royalty
programme.desc: Altman and Tracy co-list a historic Hollywood estate previously owned by Hollywood legend John Barrymore; James and David go all-in on their new East Coast traditional.

programme.title: A Swedish Soiree
programme.desc: Altman returns to his roots in the Bird Streets neighborhood to sell a modern masterpiece but has a difficult time keeping the sellers happy; Flagg adjusts to a remote work lifestyle and secretly visits Tracy's house to see an old companion.

programme.title: Counter Offer Knock Down
programme.desc: Flagg works with an old friend to sell a historic Bel Air home that is designed by a famous architect and occupied by famous owners; Tracy embraces technology in order to try and sell a property that no one is allowed to step foot in.

programme.title: Orange You Glad It's a Co-List?
programme.desc: Fredrik reels in a property in Beverly Park only to learn that the sellers want him to co-list the property with Altman; Flagg walks a fine line as he lists a tear down on a great piece of land for a seller who does not want the house torn down.

programme.title: Yippee Ki Yay!
programme.desc: Steve tries to find a buyer for a charming country home on a piece of land in Upstate New York; Ryan has two weeks to work his magic on a skyscraper; Fredrik tries to impress his clients by selling an apartment to actor Bruce Willis.

programme.title: Whale of a Sale
programme.desc: Ryan is challenged with selling the biggest townhouse in the neighborhood; Steve tries to sell an apartment with a location flaw; Fredrik gets creative to market a billion-dollar project that's in shambles; Ryan and Emilia make a major decision.

programme.title: Drumming Up Buyers
programme.desc: Fredrik may need to go back to the 1980s to find a buyer for his listing; Ryan has to sell a mansion built on top of a freeway; Steve goes to upstate New York to help a billionaire client but realizes his listing may turn out to be a "Payne."

programme.title: A New York Upstate of Mind
programme.desc: Ryan views a seven-story townhouse featuring an indoor pool; Steve's event at the 160-acre Payne Estate features ax-throwing competitions and carriage rides to rein in a big-city buyer; Fredrik works hard to sell a home with extravagant décor.

programme.title: Tech-nical Difficulties
programme.desc: Ryan pitches his brand new seven-story Chelsea townhouse as a smart-home paradise for tech enthusiasts; Luis and Ronita explore the idea of reuniting; Fredrik's former assistant, Jordan, invites him to help close the deal on a new listing in Tribeca.

programme.title: Jess We Can!
programme.desc: Ronita decides her partnership with Luis needs a tune-up; Ryan is thrilled to land three luxury properties in NoHo, but he is quickly burdened with 233 other units... all of them rentals; Steve's own apartment becomes his latest listing.

programme.title: Construction Criticism
programme.desc: Steve puts on a rubber mask to observe Jess at her first broker's open house; Fredrik follows a lead for his Tribeca listing; Ryan lands a beautifully renovated loft in Chelsea.

programme.title: The Weight Is Over
programme.desc: Ryan bets a Chelsea loft commission on a table tennis match; Steve's girlfriend settles into their new home together; Fredrik thinks his Crosby listing's massive terrace could be perfect for trained pets; a new, up-and-coming agent joins the crew.

programme.title: Polar Opposites
programme.desc: Ryan interviews young agents for his new rental team; Steve and a childhood friend hit the gym to weigh all the investment properties they've seen; Tyler invites a famous mentalist to his Mercantile open house party; Fredrik hosts an open house.

programme.title: Better Laight Than Never
programme.desc: Fredrik hustles for offers at his disco-themed open house; Steve hosts a book launching event at his open house; Tyler faces off with Ryan over a listing for a massive loft on Laight Street.

programme.title: House of Drago
programme.desc: While listing a Hamptons-esque home in Hancock Park, James and David find themselves at odds with each other; Flagg goes to the next level to protect himself and his fellow agent.

programme.title: The House That Thighmaster Built
programme.desc: Flagg packs his bags for Palm Springs to sell the home of America's favorite roommate, Suzanne Somers; Tracy balances work and family as she lists her sister's massive $30 million home in Holmby Hills.

programme.title: Two's Company, Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: After agreeing to a co-list in Bel Air, James and David struggle to get a word in edgewise during their showings; Flagg soaks in the waters of Palm Springs as he tries to sell Suzanne Somers' house.

programme.title: The Laws of Distraction
programme.desc: When Fredrik tries to get brokers to his Upper Bel Air property, he faces a huge obstacle: LA traffic; James and David create a decoy to get a sale in Bel Air; Altman negotiates against his brother.

programme.title: Have a Cookie and Relax
programme.desc: Tracy trades her broker hat for a buyer hat when she starts searching for a home in Beverly Hills and is shocked when she realizes Flagg is listing her dream house; Fredrik pushes to set a record price in Upper Bel Air.

programme.title: Gate Code Shakedown
programme.desc: Tracy goes head-to-head with Flagg on his listing in the Flats; in Beverly Hills, Altman falls in love with a midcentury masterpiece; James races to close a deal for Bernard "Harv" Harvey and his wife in the booming Valley market.

programme.title: Look Ma', We Made It
programme.desc: Tracy's Abbot Kinney property is a tough sell, but not as tough as her confrontation with Fredrik; Altman wants to make up for misbehaving as a child by giving his parents something special; Flagg's expertise is tested with a very particular buyer.

programme.title: 9021 No!
programme.desc: Fredrik and Altman return to their Beverly Park co-list with an offer, but the seller tests the bonds of their relationship; Flagg hosts an exclusive dinner party while trying to close a deal in the Beverly Hills Flats.

programme.title: Trouble in the OC
programme.desc: Even though Flagg has not found a buyer yet, Suzanne Somers' house might just sell; Tracy and her daughters check on the progress of their new house; Fredrik and Altman each snag ocean-front properties as they both want to expand into the new market.

programme.title: The Great British Cook-Off
programme.desc: Tracy's delighted to list the house of Gleb Savchenko and Elena Samodanova from "Dancing with the Stars" but it needs a facelift; the Brits get their hands dirty when hosting a dinner party at their 30-million-dollar Nightingale property.

programme.title: The One With the 7 Foot Marilyn
programme.desc: Tracy tries to dance her way to a deal on the Skyline property; Altman aims to break Brentwood records with a property that has more bells and whistles than anyone could dream of.

programme.title: The Odd Couple
programme.desc: Josh Altman and Josh Flagg enlist their spouses and head for the coast; they pull out all the stops in the hopes of securing an all-cash offer for a jeweler-client who is between a rock and a hard place.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Buy
programme.desc: Altman enlists Flagg's help in selling his parents' home in Aspen, but when news of a change in Flagg's employment leaks, all hell breaks loose; back in LA, Heather asks Bobby for advice about seeking partnership in The Altman Brothers.

programme.title: Sour Grapes
programme.desc: Flagg is blindsided when Altman decides to teach him a lesson in the middle of a high-stakes deal in wine country; Heather and Bobby are left to ponder the future of their spouses' partnership.

programme.title: On the Waterfront
programme.desc: Josh and Josh seek an elusive waterfront property for a difficult client in Newport Beach; Heather officially asks her husband and his brother, Matt, for partnership in The Altman Brothers.

programme.title: Just The Three of Us
programme.desc: Josh Altman, Josh Flagg and Tracy Tutor collaborate and compete with one another on a whole new level; Tracy takes a wild swing on a record-setting mansion; Altman gets a second chance at a listing; Flagg opens up about his divorce from Bobby.

programme.title: The First Husband's Club
programme.desc: Altman and Tracy go head-to-head on the sale of a historic property; Flagg continues to deal with both divorce and indecisive twins; Tracy's client, and her many cats, have fallen head over tails in love with a Diane Keaton property they must have.

programme.title: The Snowball Effect
programme.desc: Steve works to install an elevator in his new listing; Tyler gets a wake-up call while hosting a morning open house; Fredrik's husband's love of New York turns chilling during a raging snowstorm; Ryan re-brands a nameless neighborhood.

programme.title: Coast Stories
programme.desc: Ryan invites an illusionist to his open house; L.A. agent Josh Altman isn't thrilled that Fredrik is building a West Coast team; Steve's in a professional pickle; Tyler plans a horse carriage ride through Central Park for potential buyers.

programme.title: Loss Angeles
programme.desc: Ryan premieres a music video for his Tribeca loft; Tyler pitches the biggest listing of his career; Fredrik and Derek tour a rental home for themselves in Los Angeles, but local brokers don't give them a warm welcome; Steve gets blind-sided.

programme.title: Ruffled Heathers
programme.desc: Fredrik has a run-in with L.A. agent Heather Altman at his open house; Ryan markets a beautiful Park Avenue apartment to mysterious buyers from a secret government; Steve realizes decisions at home are easier to make than decisions with developers.

programme.title: Co-List or No-List
programme.desc: Fredrik lands a prime listing in SoHo that everyone, except Tyler, says is amazing; Steve asks Jess to help with a Bedford-Stuyvesant listing, but their contrasting selling styles may sink the deal; a seller steers Ryan towards hiring Luis.

programme.title: Four Men and a Baby
programme.desc: Ryan and Luis host a dinner party to sell their listing but struggle to rein in Ramona Singer; Fredrik's listing isn't big enough to satisfy his buyer's needs, so he tries to sell her a different unit, even if it's one he doesn't represent.

programme.title: New Girl on the Block
programme.desc: Ryan lists a unique $18 million townhouse with commercial space; Tyler gears up to sell his biggest listing ever; Steve snags a listing but must work to attract attention for this hidden gem; Kirsten comes in hot as the new broker on the block.

programme.title: Freddy's Back!
programme.desc: Fredrik catwalks his way to a potential deal with a former supermodel; Ryan hopes to make a splash at his open house; Tyler battles to sell the biggest listing of his career; KJ hosts a sparkling aperitivo to court interest from expats.

programme.title: House of Style
programme.desc: Ryan suits up to sell designer Marc Jacobs' swanky West Village townhouse; KJ brings in an interested buyer; Steve whets the appetite with a tasty open house; Tyler is challenged to sell a property across from a police and fire station.

programme.title: Townhouse in the Sky
programme.desc: Ryan scores a two-for-one property with a hidden apartment; Steve seals the deal on a historical property in NYC's beloved Ansonia building; KJ is faced with closing the Townhouse in the Sky, but she struggles to make her toughest client happy.

programme.title: A Game of Cat and House
programme.desc: Tracy brings Flagg in on a deal; Altman mentors a new broker who once took a chance on him only to find out that the tables are turned.

programme.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
programme.desc: Tracy and Heather prove that two blondes are better than one when they score more than they bargained for after teaming up to sell a Beverly Hills home; Flagg discovers that Marilyn Monroe once called his new listing home.

programme.title: To Sell or Not to Sell
programme.desc: Tracy's latest listing yields an interesting new development; Josh Altman and Heather clash after having different reactions to an unexpected offer that comes knocking on their door; Josh Flagg reveals a new mystery man in his life.

programme.title: The Rocky Hazen Picture Show
programme.desc: Flagg and Altman team up to sell a deluxe apartment in the sky; Tracy and Heather join forces to sell the dream on a coveted Beverly Hills listing; neither is as easy as it seems.

programme.title: Rate Hikes and Date Nights
programme.desc: A downturn in the market is no longer conjecture but reality, which comes as a rude awakening to Altman, Flagg and Tracy; the good news is that Flagg, at least, has a pleasant new distraction named Andrew.

programme.title: Breakin' Up Is Hard to Do
programme.desc: Flagg comes face to face with his ex; Altman may run L.A., but he's still got plenty to prove in the OC; Tracy puts Juliet to work.

programme.title: Commission Omission
programme.desc: Altman and Flagg revisit a site of a previous throwdown; Tracy has fun with one of Altman's agents.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho (Jackie Chan), an undercover operative for the CIA, decides to give up his career and marry his girlfriend, Gillian (Amber Valletta). First however, he has one more mission to complete: Gain the approval of Gillian's children. Bob volunteers to baby-sit when Gillian is called away, but the operation hits a snag when one of the kids mistakenly downloads a top-secret formula, and a Russian terrorist takes aim at Bob's prospective family.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven
programme.desc: In this animated feature, canine casino owner Charlie (Burt Reynolds) is killed by gambler Carface (Vic Tayback), but returns to Earth from heaven thanks to the powers of a magical, rewindable watch. Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.desc: After Opie is struck with puppy love, Barney tries to show him how to handle women.

programme.title: A Wife for Andy
programme.desc: Barney thinks it's time Andy got married, but Andy has a plan of his own.

programme.title: Dogs, Dogs, Dogs
programme.desc: A pack of hunting dogs overruns the Mayberry courthouse just as Andy is trying to impress a state official.

programme.title: Jed Rescues Pearl
programme.desc: Pearl's attempts to snag Mr. Brewster seem hopeless until he suddenly makes an outrageous public proposal.

programme.title: Back to Californy
programme.desc: Jed is confronted with too many cooks and not enough vittles when he invites Pearl and Jethrine to Beverly Hills.

programme.title: Jed's Dilemma
programme.desc: Trying to cool a feud between Granny and Pearl, Jed takes his family on a sightseeing tour of Beverly Hills.

programme.title: Mountain Wedding
programme.desc: The Darling family returns to Mayberry and asks Andy for help in dealing with Ernest T. Bass, a mountain man who keeps pursuing Briscoe's married daughter Charlene.

programme.title: The Big House
programme.desc: Barney and Gomer are responsible for watching over two thieves who are temporarily jailed in Mayberry. Between the two of them, the criminals manage to escape three times.

programme.title: High Noon in Mayberry
programme.desc: Barney orders Gomer and Otis to keep watch on Andy when an ex-con Andy sent to prison many years before returns to Mayberry.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: I Hate Kids
programme.desc: Nick Pearson is a life-long bachelor who is finally settling down. On the brink of his wedding, he is surprised to find he has a 13-year-old son who located him through the help of a psychic. Nick can't stand kids and would happily send the boy back to live with his biological mother, but nobody knows who the woman might be. Having nowhere to turn, Nick must hit the road with the boy and the neurotic psychic to locate dozens of his ex-flings and ask one very awkward question to all of them.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad
programme.desc: Con man Ray Gleason (Ted Danson) is going after one last heist -- a stash of rare coins -- when his estranged son, Timmy (Macaulay Culkin), unexpectedly shows up. Ray is too busy with his robbery to spend much time with his son, so Timmy decides to blackmail Ray into acting like a father. He hides the coins and promises to give them back only after Ray takes him to amusement parks and baseball games. All the while, Detective Theresa Walsh (Glenne Headly) is closing in on Ray.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
programme.desc: Comic Sinbad discusses the life advice his family gave him; why he's tired of people with no talent having clothing lines; who he really is.

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: After losing yet another job, George (Weird Al Yankovic) wonders if there is any career that can handle his outrageous personality. When George's uncle (Stanley Brock) hands him the deed to a local TV station, George creates a series of television shows based on social satire and hyperactive humor, with the help of his best friend, Bob (David Bowe). However, a rival station's bitter CEO (Kevin McCarthy) tries to destroy George's wacky programming, forcing him to fight back.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH
programme.desc: Mrs. Brisby (Elizabeth Hartman), a widowed mouse, must move her children out of their home in a field before the local farmer starts plowing. Unable to leave because her son is ill, Mrs. Brisby seeks the help of nearby rats, who have heightened intelligence after being the subjects of scientific experiments. She receives an unexpected gift from the elder rat, Nicodemus (Derek Jacobi). Soon Mrs. Brisby is caught in a conflict among the rats, jeopardizing her mission to save her family.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias Presents: The Gentleman Jerry Rocha
programme.desc: The comic performs.

programme.title: Silence, Souvenirs, and Sleepless Nights
programme.desc: A stern bookseller, sketchy eye care, nostalgic cravings, and a failed camping trip.

programme.title: Pizza, Puppets, and Passionate Play
programme.desc: Geppetto brings Pinocchio to life, a stressed pizza shop, and a dramatic dinner table.

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
programme.desc: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

programme.title: The Little Train Robbery
programme.desc: A pair of crooks plans to rob the Cannonball of its bank shipment.

programme.title: Bedloe Strikes Again
programme.desc: Homer returns to Shady Rest in an attempt to scrap the Cannonball.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: An All Dogs Christmas Carol
programme.desc: In this animated adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic book, Christmas is coming, and pooch pals Itchy (Dom DeLuise), Charlie Barkin (Steve Weber) and Sasha (Sheena Easton) decide to raise enough cash for injured pup Timmy to get a much-needed operation. Unfortunately, mean-spirited canines Carface (Ernest Borgnine) and Killer (Charles Nelson Reilly) rob the kindhearted dogs before they can give Timmy his present, prompting Charlie and the gang to concoct a ghostly plan to retrieve their money.

programme.title: The Loaded Goat
programme.desc: Andy and Barney must figure out a way to prevent a farmer's goat who has eaten a load of dynamite from blowing up Mayberry.

programme.title: Class Reunion
programme.desc: Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.

programme.title: Return to Green Acres
programme.desc: Cast members from the original TV series are reunited when Oliver tries to save Hooterville from greedy developers.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Washed-up stuntman Luo can barely make ends meet, let alone take care of his beloved stunt horse, Red Hare. Luo reluctantly seeks help from his estranged daughter and her lawyer boyfriend when notified the horse may be auctioned off to pay his debts. Luo and Red Hare become an overnight media sensation when their fight with debt collectors goes viral.

programme.title: Spare Parts
programme.desc: With the help of their high school's newest teacher (George Lopez), four Hispanic students form a robotics club. Although they have no experience, the youths set their sights on a national robotics contest. With $800 and parts scavenged from old cars, they build a robot and compete against reigning champion MIT. Along the way, the students learn not only how to build a robot but something far more important: how to forge bonds that will last a lifetime.

programme.title: Why Can't We Be Friends?
programme.desc: George has been ignoring his son.

programme.title: Having My Baby
programme.desc: Alma is convinced that Harper is not George's son and orders a DNA test.

programme.title: Superstition
programme.desc: George is forced to make a will and is convinced he's going to die.

programme.title: Carry on Wayward Son
programme.desc: George becomes a nursemaid.

programme.title: Hit Me With Your Best Shot
programme.desc: George kicks Alma out of his house and discovers he misses fighting with her.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
programme.desc: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Lazer Team
programme.desc: After stumbling across a crash site, four misfits must use an extraterrestrial battle suit to save mankind.

programme.title: Lazer Team 2
programme.desc: The members of Lazer Team travel through a wormhole to rescue their friend.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Washed-up stuntman Luo can barely make ends meet, let alone take care of his beloved stunt horse, Red Hare. Luo reluctantly seeks help from his estranged daughter and her lawyer boyfriend when notified the horse may be auctioned off to pay his debts. Luo and Red Hare become an overnight media sensation when their fight with debt collectors goes viral.

programme.title: Snack Time
programme.desc: Chick eats seed out of man's mouth; Riley the dog gets ice from ice machine; chipmunk digging in coffee can for nut.

programme.title: Man's Best Friend
programme.desc: Dog plays with a ball like a seal; doggie go-round; dog attacks lady's slippers.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven
programme.desc: In this animated feature, canine casino owner Charlie (Burt Reynolds) is killed by gambler Carface (Vic Tayback), but returns to Earth from heaven thanks to the powers of a magical, rewindable watch. Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Funniest Pets and People is a solid half-hour of pure entertainment with a proven format featuring hysterical, fast-paced video clips submitted by viewers who share the funniest moments of their favorite Pets and People.

programme.title: Ring Around the Rosie
programme.desc: Horses howl with a conductor; Lulu runs and jumps over people near fountain; three peacocks play ring around the Rosie.

programme.title: Good Boy!
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, dogs arrived on planet Earth from a faraway star with plans to take over the world. Now, the Greater Dane (Vanessa Redgrave) wants a report on the takeover, so she sends Hubble (Matthew Broderick) to investigate. When he's adopted by the lonely Owen (Liam Aiken), Hubble slowly realizes that dogs have forgotten their mission. They're not man's worst enemy -- they're his best friend. And, to make matters worse, the Greater Dane is headed to Earth for an inspection.

programme.title: Bait Shop
programme.desc: The owner (Bill Engvall) of a small-town bait shop competes in a fishing tournament for the prize money to save his business.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Crooks (Jackie Chan, Louis Koo) grow attached to the baby they kidnapped.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Jack (Jackie Chan), a world-renowned archaeology professor, and his team are on a grand quest to locate a lost ancient Indian treasure when they are ambushed by a team of mercenaries and left for dead. Using his vast knowledge of history and kung fu, Jack leads his team on a race around the world to beat the mercenaries to the treasure and save an ancient culture.

programme.title: Rafe Hollister Sings
programme.desc: Rafe Hollister, a farmer with a golden voice, is chosen to represent Mayberry at a musical, but Mayor Stoner believes he looks too seedy. It is then up to Andy to make Rafe presentable enough.

programme.title: El taller mecánico

programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano acompañan a Lupita al mandado lo que no es una buena decisión porque tienen que enfrentarse al güero, mientras que doña Cuca y Nacho se quedan solos en casa.

programme.title: Episode 23
programme.desc: Rosie lights up a party with her neon fireworks crate cake.

programme.title: Starring Olive Oil

programme.title: Foraging Adventures
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Ingredients that were foraged included asparagus, mushrooms, clams, and mussels, and this seasonal adventure was always extremely exciting. Lidia begins with a hearty Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu. She then gets on videochat with her grandson, Lorenzo, for an Asparagus Gratin Topped with Fried Egg. Her Clam Soup is perfect for a weeknight dinner!

programme.title: Grandma's Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads.to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joing her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple cake.

programme.title: Heartwarming Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: The Industry of Food
programme.desc: Industrialization triggers the second great food revolution, transforming people's diets.

programme.title: Art in Harlem
programme.desc: Chez Lucienne and Gin Fizz are two intimate and convivial hot spots that greatly add to Harlem's mystique, as do Faction Art Projects and Artistic Noise, both of which have helped elevate Harlem's art scene to another level of success.

programme.title: Lady Lexis Sweets
programme.desc: Meet the mastermind behind Lady Lexis Sweets and the delicious treats found there, visit Ginny's Supper Club for an intimate conversation with Author Monica Rich Kosann and Journalist Tamron Hall, and experience the energy of Double Dutch.

programme.desc: Julia Child tours a California vineyard to learn about fine wines. At dinner, her first course is Loin of Pork, Wellington, while her guest chef prepares Salmon Souffles. With Brooks Firestone and Rene Verdon.

programme.title: episode 8
programme.desc: In this final episode Rory prepares carrot, coconut and lemon grass soup followed by slow roast shoulder of lamb with aioli and salsa verde and rhubarb and strawberry trifle with almonds and pistachios to finish.

programme.title: episode 8
programme.desc: Moroccan harrira soup. Roast haddock with roast pepper, olive and basil salsa. Mashed potatoes with courgette, olive oil and marjoram. Romanesco. Chocolate, prune and armagnac puddings with chocolate sauce.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: Onion Odyssey
programme.desc: Chef Dev prepares some of his favorite street food dishes from around the world that feature onions, including Seeni Sambol Buns from Sri Lanka, a Blooming Onion from the USA, and Scallion Pancakes from South Korea.

programme.title: Tuna Casserole
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Tuna Casserole! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Croque Madame
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Croque Madame! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Lifford/Maine & New Hampshire
programme.desc: In this episode, we first travel to Donegal to meet Ann to find out who is living away from home. Later Ann rustles up the dishes that remind James and Monica of home in Donegal, Snowballs and an Apple Pie. Catherine then travels to the US in hope to replicate Ann's dishes and bring a taste like home over to James and Monica.

programme.title: Kirk Franklin and Erica Campbell
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle introduces long-time friend and gospel superstar, Kirk Franklin, and his wife, Tammy, to her Famous Fried Chicken. Nothing says "yum" like golden-brown, delicious fried chicken served with Sauteed Potatoes and Onions, along with Garlicky Broccoli Rabe. Later, Erica Campbell, from the legendary gospel duo Mary Mary, stops by and she and Patti make a simple and delicious double-layer Peach Cobbler.

programme.title: Estelle and Joe Zee
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites her friend, fashion guru Joe Zee, over for a simple Shrimp Scampi served over Angel Hair Pasta. She tops off the meal with Apple-Peach Compote and Vanilla Ice Cream. Then, British Grammy Award-winning singer Estelle comes by and Patti makes her feel right at home with her very own version of Fish and Chips with Tartar Sauce.

programme.title: Carrie Ann Inaba and Cedric the Entertainer
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites comedian Cedric the Entertainer over for a hearty meal. They laugh out loud in the kitchen as Patti cooks up juicy and tender lamb chops served with candied sweet potatoes and fresh sauteed spinach. Then, Dancing with the Stars judge Carrie Ann Inaba stops by for a sweet treat, and Patti makes it a family affair when she prepares Aunt Hattie Mae's Raspberry Pie -- a simple and delicious dessert that's a perfect 10.

programme.title: Spice Blends
programme.desc: Spices were meant to be used in tandem, and our co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud will show you how! Cook along as they make a creamy, golden, Risotto Milanese, spiced not just with saffron, but with Ras el Hanout: a spice blend like no other! Next, a master class in spice blends and infusing them into oils, all topped off with some skewers of plump, juicy grilled shrimp. Finally, delicate Red Snapper is coated in aromatic Dukkah and served with a fresh Tomato and Chickpea Salad!

programme.title: Meet the Peppers
programme.desc: Chefs Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim have picked a peck of peppery recipes this time on Spice Secrets! Start off with something sweet: strawberry shortcakes featuring three different peppercorns: black, white, and pink! After that, a Japanese take on Tuna Ceviche when they infuse a trio of smoky Mexican chili peppers into citrusy ponzu sauce! And who can resist crispy fried chicken wings? Especially when they're spiced up with Chinese five-spice and served with a Sichuan pepper hot honey!

programme.title: Kerala
programme.desc: Gordon ends his travels to India by heading south, living in an ashram in Kerala and working alongside one of India's top chefs in Mumbai.

programme.title: Scallops & Pork
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the more tantalizing dish! The catch? Each of their plates must prominently feature both scallops and pork tenderloin!

The next dish continues the theme of duality: Corn Two Ways! A creamy corn puree and a fried corn fritter! Next, a pizza for when you can't make up your mind. Half classic margherita, half gorgonzola, duck confit and pear. Finally, Geminis like chef Siobhan like to turn things on their heads, like her dessert of a Pineapple Upside-Down Cake!

programme.title: Whole Hog
programme.desc: See what happens when 3 chefs turn leftover brisket into something unexpected.

programme.title: Benin

The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: In tonight's show, Nicole Appleton, Melanie Blatt and their mums cook a delicious starter of angel hair pasta & clams, spiced pork chops with crushed sweet potatoes and a classic apple tart

programme.title: The Takeover

programme.title: Spaghetti Flambe
programme.desc: Julia Child shares another gem to add to your treasury of three-course dinners. Everyday ingredients put together with a flare.

programme.title: Riegersburg Castle

programme.title: Chillingham Castle

programme.title: Casting The Net Wide On Tybee Island
programme.desc: Tybee Island is home to fun locals, a deep history, and, of course, seafood so delicious that it, alone, was enough reason for Skye to make a return trip.

programme.title: BBQ Bonanza

programme.title: French Fridays
programme.desc: Prepare to feast on fantastic French cuisine on Xumo Free Food TV, as top chefs cook up culinary masterpieces right in your living room!

programme.title: Salads

Today, a top notch salad contains many different colours, shapes, sizes, textures and flavours. As well as lettuces, it may also include the leaves of Arugula, Radicchio, Spinach, Cress, Mustards and Herbs.

programme.title: Celery and Celeriac
programme.desc: Karen agrees to grow celery despite her dislike of it, and also celeriac which she considers the "pug" of the vegetable world - so ugly that it's cute.
